questions.question: $\sin ^{-1} \frac{4}{5}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
চিত্র হতে, $\cos ^{-1} \frac{-2}{\sqrt{5}}=\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}$


প্রদত্ত রাশি $=\sin ^{-1} \frac{4}{5}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}$


$=\sin ^{-1} \frac{4}{5}+\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}$


$=\sin ^{-1}\left\{\frac{4}{5} \cdot \sqrt{1-\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\right)^{2}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \cdot \sqrt{1-\left(\frac{4}{5}\right)^{2}}\right\}$


$=\sin ^{-1}\left\{\frac{4}{5} \cdot \sqrt{1-\frac{1}{5}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \cdot \sqrt{1-\frac{16}{25}}\right\}$


$=\sin ^{-1}\left\{\frac{4}{5} \cdot \sqrt{\frac{4}{5}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \cdot \sqrt{\frac{9}{25}}\right\}$


$=\sin ^{-1}\left\{\frac{4}{5} \times \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \times \frac{3}{5}\right\}=\sin ^{-1}\left\{\frac{8+3}{5 \sqrt{5}}\right\}=\sin ^{-1} \frac{11}{5 \sqrt{5}}$


$\therefore \sin ^{-1} \frac{4}{5}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}=\sin ^{-1} \frac{11}{5 \sqrt{5}}$

questions.question: $f(x)+g\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)+f(3 x)=1+g(x)+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)$ সমীকরণটির সমাধান কর।
questions.answer:
এখানে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\sin \mathrm{x} \quad$ এবং $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{y})=\cos \mathrm{y}$


$\therefore \mathrm{f}(3 \mathrm{x})=\sin 3 \mathrm{x} \quad \therefore \mathrm{g}(\mathrm{y})=\cos \mathrm{x}$


এবং $f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)$ এবং $g\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)$


$=\cos 2 \mathrm{x}$ $\quad$ $=\sin 2 \mathrm{x}$


প্রদত্ত সমীকরণ, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+\mathrm{g}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \mathrm{x}\right)+\mathrm{f}(3 \mathrm{x})=1+\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})+\mathrm{f}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \mathrm{x}\right)$


বা, $\sin x+\sin 2 x+\sin 3 x=1+\cos x+\cos 2 x$ বা, $\sin 3 x+\sin x+\sin 2 x=1+\cos 2 x+\cos x$


বা, $2 \cdot \sin \frac{3 x+x}{2} \cos \frac{3 x-x}{2}+\sin 2 x=2 \cos ^{2} x+\cos x$


বা, $2 \sin 2 x \cos x+\sin 2 x=\cos x(2 \cos x+1)$


বা, $\sin 2 x(2 \cos x+1)=\cos x(2 \cos x+1)$


বা, $\sin 2 x(2 \cos x+1)-\cos x(2 \cos x+1)$


বা, $(2 \cos x+1)(\sin 2 x-\cos x)=0$


হয়, $2 \cos x+1=0$


অথবা, $\sin 2 \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x}=0$


বা, $\cos x=-\frac{1}{2}$


$\text { বা, } 2 \sin x \cos x-\cos x=0$


বা, $\cos x(2 \sin x-1)=0$


বা, $\cos x=-\cos \frac{\pi}{3} \quad$ আবার, $\cos x=0 \quad$ অথবা, $2 \sin x-1=0$


বা, $\cos x=\cos \left(\pi-\frac{\pi}{3}\right) \quad$ বা, $\cos x=\cos \frac{\pi}{2} \quad$ বা, $\sin x=\frac{1}{2}$


বা, $\cos x=\cos \frac{2 \pi}{3} \quad \therefore x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2} \quad$ বা, $\sin x=\sin \frac{\pi}{6}$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{2 \pi}{3} \quad$ যেখানে $\mathrm{n}$ পূর্ণসংখ্যা $\quad \therefore \mathrm{x}=\mathrm{n} \pi+(-1)^{\mathrm{n}} \frac{\pi}{6}$


যেখানে $n$ পূর্ণসংখ্যা $\quad$যেখানে $n$ পূর্ণসংখ্যা


নির্ণেয় সমাধান, $(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2}, 2 n \pi \pm \frac{2 \pi}{3}, n \pi+(-1)^{n} \frac{\pi}{6}$;


যেখানে $\mathbf{n}$ যেকোনো পূর্ণসংখ্যা।

এখানে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\sin \mathrm{x}$ এবং $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{y})=\cos \mathrm{y}$


সুতরাং, $2 \tan ^{-1} \frac{\mathrm{f}\left(\frac{\alpha}{2}\right)}{\mathrm{f}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{\alpha}{2}\right)} \tan \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)=\tan ^{-1} \frac{\mathrm{f}(\alpha) \cdot \mathrm{f}(\beta)}{\mathrm{g}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\beta\right)+\mathrm{f}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)}$


বা, $2 \tan ^{-1} \frac{\sin \frac{\alpha}{2}}{\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{\alpha}{2}\right)} \tan \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)=\tan ^{-1} \frac{\sin \alpha \cdot \cos \beta}{\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\beta\right)+\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)}$


বা, $2 \tan ^{-1} \frac{\sin \frac{\alpha}{2}}{\cos \frac{\alpha}{2}} \tan \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)=\tan ^{-1} \frac{\sin \alpha \cdot \cos \beta}{\sin \beta+\cos \alpha}$


বামপক্ষ $=2 \tan ^{-1} \frac{\sin \frac{\alpha}{2}}{\cos \frac{\alpha}{2}} \tan \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)$


$\begin{aligned}& =2 \tan ^{-1} \frac{\sin \frac{\alpha}{2} \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}{\cos \frac{\alpha}{2} \cdot \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}=\tan ^{-1} \frac{2 \cdot \frac{\sin \frac{\alpha}{2} \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}{\cos \frac{\alpha}{2} \cdot \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}}{1-\frac{\sin ^{2} \frac{\alpha}{2} \sin ^{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}{\cos ^{2} \frac{\alpha}{2} \cos ^{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{2 \cdot \frac{\sin \frac{\alpha}{2} \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}{\cos \frac{\alpha}{2} \cdot \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}}{\frac{\cos ^{2} \frac{\alpha}{2} \cos ^{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)-\sin ^{2} \frac{\alpha}{2} \sin ^{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}{\cos ^{2} \frac{\alpha}{2} \sin ^{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{2 \sin \frac{\alpha}{2} \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right) \cdot \cos \frac{\alpha}{2} \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}{\left\{\cos \frac{\alpha}{2} \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)\right\}^{2}-\left\{\sin \frac{\alpha}{2} \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)\right\}^{2}} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \sin \frac{\alpha}{2} \cos \frac{\alpha}{2} \cdot 2 \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right) \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}{\left.\left\{\cos \frac{\alpha}{2} \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)+\sin \frac{\alpha}{2} \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)\right\} \cos \frac{\alpha}{2} \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)-\sin \frac{\alpha}{2} \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)\right\}} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{\sin \alpha \sin 2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)}{\cos \alpha+\cos \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}+\beta\right)} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{\sin \alpha \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\beta\right)}{\cos \left(\frac{\alpha}{2}-\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\beta}{2}+\frac{\alpha}{2}+\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\beta}{2}\right)+\cos \left(\frac{\alpha}{2}-\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\beta}{2}-\frac{\alpha}{2}-\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\beta}{2}\right)} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{\sin \alpha \cdot \cos \beta}{\cos \alpha+\cos \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}+\beta\right)} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{\sin \alpha \cos \beta}{\cos \alpha+\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\beta\right)}[\because \cos (-\theta)=\cos \theta] \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{\sin \alpha \cdot \cos \beta}{\sin \beta+\cos \alpha}\end{aligned}$

questions.question: $\cos ^{-1} \sin \cos ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ এর মুখ্য মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
প্রদত্ত রাশি, $=\cos ^{-1} \sin \cos ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$


$\begin{aligned}& =\cos ^{-1} \sin \sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \\& =\cos ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}=\frac{\pi}{4}\end{aligned}$


নির্ণেয় মূখ্যমান : $\frac{\pi}{4}$.

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ হতে দেখাও যে, $\mathrm{A}=\tan ^{-1} 3$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $A=3 \sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}$


বামপক্ষ = A


$=3 \sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}$


$=\sin ^{-1}\left\{3 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}-4 \cdot\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^{3}\right\}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\left[\because 3 \sin ^{-1} x=\sin ^{-1}\left(3 x-4 x^{3}\right]\right.$


$=\sin ^{-1}\left\{\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}-\frac{4}{2 \sqrt{2}}\right\}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}$


$=\sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)+\cos ^{-1} \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}$


$=\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}$


$=\tan ^{-1} 1+\tan \frac{1}{2}$


[চিত্র-১ ও চিত্র-২ হতে]


$=\tan ^{-1} \frac{1+\frac{1}{2}}{1-1 \cdot \frac{1}{2}}=\tan ^{-1} \frac{\frac{3}{2}}{\frac{1}{2}}$


$=\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{2} \times \frac{2}{1}\right)=\tan ^{-1} 3=$ ডানপক্ষ


অর্থাৎ, $\mathrm{A}=\tan ^{-1} 3$ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে $2\{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})\}^{2}-11 \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+5=0$ সমীকরণটির সমাধান কর। যেখানে $0^{0} \leq \mathrm{x} \leq 2 \pi$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{x}\right)=\sin \mathrm{x}$


প্রদত্ত সমীকরণ, $2\{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})\}^{2}-11 \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+5=0$


বা, , $2(\sin x)^{2}-11 \sin x+5=0$


বা, $2 \sin ^{2} x-11 \sin x+5=0$


বা, , $2 \sin ^{2} x-10 \sin x-\sin x+5=0$


বা, , $2 \sin x(\sin x-5)-1(\sin x-5)=0$


বা, $(\sin x-5)(2 \sin x-1)=0$


হয়, $2 \sin x-1=0 \quad$ অথবা, $\sin x-5=0$


বা, $\sin x=\frac{1}{2} \quad$ বা, $\sin x=5$ কিন্তু ইহা গ্রহণয়াগ্য নয়।


বা, $\sin x=\sin \frac{\pi}{6} \quad$ কেননা $-1 \leq \sin x \leq 1$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}=\mathrm{n} \pi+(-1)^{\mathrm{n}} \frac{\pi}{6}$ যেখানে $\mathrm{n}$ যেকোনো পূর্ণসংখ্যা।


$\mathrm{n}=0$ হলে, $\mathrm{x}=\frac{\pi}{6}$


$\mathrm{n}=1$ হলে, $\mathrm{x}=\pi+(-1)^{1} \frac{\pi}{6}=\pi-\frac{\pi}{6}=\frac{5 \pi}{6}$


$\mathrm{n}=2$ হলে, $\mathrm{x}=2 \pi+(-1)^{2} \frac{\pi}{6}=2 \pi+\frac{\pi}{6}=\frac{13 \pi}{6}$


$\therefore 0 \leq \mathrm{x} \leq 2 \pi$ ব্যর্বধিতে $\mathrm{x}$ এর গ্রহণ্যোগ্য মানসমূহ $\frac{\square}{6}, \frac{5 \pi}{6}$


নির্ণেয় সমাধান : $x=\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5 \pi}{6}$.

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\sin ^{2}\left(\cos ^{-1} \frac{1}{3}\right)-\cos ^{2}\left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)=\frac{2}{9}$.
questions.answer:
$\begin{aligned}\text { বামপক্ষ } & =\sin ^{2}\left(\cos ^{-1} \frac{1}{3}\right)-\cos ^{2}\left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right) \\& =1-\cos ^{2}\left(\cos ^{-1} \frac{1}{3}\right)-\left\{1-\sin ^{2}\left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)\right\} \\& =1-\left\{\cos \left(\cos ^{-1} \frac{1}{3}\right)\right\}^{2}-1+\left\{\sin \left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)\right\}^{2} \\& =-\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^{2} \\& =-\frac{1}{9}+\frac{1}{3}=\frac{-1+3}{9}=\frac{2}{9} \\& =\text { ডানপক্ষ }\end{aligned}$


$\therefore \sin ^{2}\left(\cos ^{-1} \frac{1}{3}\right)-\cos ^{2}\left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)=\frac{2}{9}$ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $\varphi(x)+\varphi(y)+\varphi(z)=\pi$ হলে দেখাও যে, $x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}+2 x y z=1$
questions.answer:
$\varphi(\mathrm{x})+\varphi(\mathrm{y})+\varphi(\mathrm{z})=\pi \text { হলে, }$


বা, $\cos ^{-1} \mathrm{x}+\cos ^{-1} \mathrm{y}+\cos ^{-1} \mathrm{z}=\pi$


বা, $\cos ^{-1}\left\{x y-\sqrt{\left(1-x^{2}\right)\left(1-y^{2}\right)}\right\}=\pi-\cos ^{-1} z$


বা, $x y-\sqrt{\left(1-x^{2}\right)\left(1-y^{2}\right)}=\cos \left(\pi-\cos ^{-1} z\right)$


বা, $x y-\sqrt{\left(1-x^{2}\right)\left(1-y^{2}\right)}=-\cos \left(\cos ^{-1} z\right)$


বা, $x y-\sqrt{\left(1-x^{2}\right)\left(1-y^{2}\right)}=-z$


বা, $\sqrt{\left(1-x^{2}\right)\left(1-y^{2}\right)}=z+x y$


বা, $\left(1-x^{2}\right)\left(1-y^{2}\right)=(z+x y)^{2}$ [বর্গ করে ]


বা, $1-y^{2}-x^{2}+x^{2} y^{2}=z^{2}+x^{2} y^{2}+2 x y z$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}^{2}+\mathrm{y}^{2}+\mathrm{z}^{2}+2 \mathrm{xyz}=1$ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: $(-\pi, \pi)$ ব্যবধিতে $h(\theta)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ সমীকরণটির সমাধান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{h}(\theta)=\cos \theta-\sin \theta$


প্রদত্ত সমীকরণ, $h(\theta)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$


বা, $\cos \theta-\sin \theta=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$


বা, $(\cos \theta-\sin \theta)^{2}=\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^{2}$ [বর্গ করে]


বা, $\cos ^{2} \theta+\sin ^{2} \theta-2 \sin \theta \cos \theta=\frac{1}{2}$


বা, $1-\sin 2 \theta=\frac{1}{2}$


বা, $\sin 2 \theta=1-\frac{1}{2}$


বা, $\sin 2 \theta=\frac{1}{2}$


বা, $\sin 2 \theta=\sin \frac{\pi}{6}$


বা, $2 \theta=\mathrm{n} \pi+(-1)^{\mathrm{n}} \frac{\pi}{6}$


বা, $\theta=\frac{\mathrm{n} \pi}{2}+(-1)^{\mathrm{n}} \frac{\pi}{12}$, बেখানে $\mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


এখন, $\mathrm{n}=0$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{\pi}{12}$


$\mathrm{n}=1$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{5 \pi}{12}$


$\mathrm{n}=-1$ হলে, $\theta=-\frac{7 \pi}{12}$


$\mathrm{n}=2$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{13 \pi}{12}$


$\mathrm{n}=-2$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{-11 \pi}{12}$.


$\mathrm{n}=3$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{17 \pi}{12}$


$\mathrm{n}=-3$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{-19 \pi}{12}$


কিন্তু $\frac{5 \pi}{12}$ এবং $\frac{-11 \pi}{12}$ মানসমূহ $(-\pi, \pi)$ ব্যবধিতে থাকলে ও মানগুলি দ্বারা সমীকরণটি সিদ্ধ হয় না


$\therefore(-\pi, \pi)$ ব্যবধিতে $\theta$ এর মানসমূহ: $\frac{\pi}{12}, \frac{-7 \pi}{12}$


নির্ণেয় সমাধান : $\theta=\frac{\pi}{12}, \frac{-7 \pi}{12}$.

questions.question: $\cos ^{2}\left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)$ এর মান বের কর।
questions.answer:
প্রদত্ত রাশি $=\cos ^{2}\left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)$.


$\begin{aligned}& =1-\sin ^{2}\left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right) \\& =1-\left(\sin \sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^{2}=1-\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^{2}=1-\frac{1}{3}=\frac{2}{3}\end{aligned}$


নির্ণেয় মান : $\frac{2}{3}$

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\sin ^{-1}(\sqrt{2} \mathbf{f}(\theta))+\sin ^{-1}\left(\sqrt{\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-20\right)}\right)=\frac{\pi}{2}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(\theta)=\sin \theta$


$\therefore f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta\right)=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta\right)=\cos 2 \theta$


বামপক্ষ $\left.=\sin ^{-1}\{\sqrt{2} \mathrm{f}(\theta)\}+\sin ^{-1}\left(\sqrt{f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta\right.}\right)\right)$


$=\sin ^{-1}(\sqrt{2} \sin \theta)+\sin ^{-1}(\sqrt{\cos 2 \theta})$


$=\sin ^{-1}\left\{\sqrt{2} \sin \theta \sqrt{1-\cos 2 \theta}+\sqrt{\cos 2 \theta} \sqrt{1-2 \sin ^{2} \theta}\right\}$


$=\sin ^{-1}\left\{\sqrt{2} \sin \theta \sqrt{2 \sin ^{2} \theta}+\sqrt{\cos 2 \theta} \cdot \sqrt{\cos 2 \theta}\right\}$


$=\sin ^{-1}\{\sqrt{2} \sin \theta \cdot \sqrt{2} \sin \theta+\cos 2 \theta\}$


$=\sin ^{-1}\left\{2 \sin ^{2} \theta+1-2 \sin ^{2} \theta\right\}$


$=\sin ^{-1} 1=\frac{\pi}{2}=5$ ডানপক


$\therefore \sin ^{-1}(\sqrt{2} f(\theta))+\sin ^{-1}\left(\sqrt{\mathrm{f}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta\right)}\right)=\frac{\pi}{2}$ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: সমাধান কর : $\mathbf{f}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\boldsymbol{\theta}\right)+\sqrt{3} \mathbf{f}(\boldsymbol{\theta})=\sqrt{2}$ ।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)+\sqrt{3} f(\theta)=\sqrt{2}$


বা, $\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)+\sqrt{3} \sin \theta=\sqrt{2}$


বা, $\cos \theta+\sqrt{3} \sin \theta=\sqrt{2}$


বা, $\frac{1}{2} \cos \theta+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \sin \theta=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$


[উভয় পক্ষকে $\sqrt{1^{2}+(\sqrt{3})^{2}}=2$ দ্বারা ভাগ করে]


বা, $\cos \frac{\pi}{3} \cdot \cos \theta+\sin \frac{\pi}{3} \sin \theta=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$


বা, $\cos \left(\theta-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=\cos \frac{\pi}{4}$


বা, $\theta-\frac{\pi}{3}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{4} ; \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


বা, $\theta=2 \mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\therefore \theta=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{7 \pi}{12}, 2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{12}$ যেখানে $\mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{z}$


নির্ণেয় সমাধান  : $\theta=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{7 \pi}{12}, 2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{12}$ যেখানে $\mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{z}$.

questions.question: $\cos ^{-1}\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)$ এর মুখ্যমান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\begin{aligned}\cos ^{-1}\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right) & =\cos ^{-1}\left(-\cos \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \\& =\cos ^{-1}\left\{\cos \left(\pi-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)\right\} \\& =\cos ^{-1} \cos \frac{2 \pi}{3}=\frac{2 \pi}{3}\end{aligned}$


$\therefore \cos ^{-1}\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)$ এর মুখ্যমান হনো : $\frac{2 \pi}{3}$.

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এর সমাধান কর যেখানে $-2 \pi \leq \theta \leq 2 \pi$.
questions.answer:
দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এ


প্রদত্ত সমীকরণ, $2 \sin ^{2} \theta-2=\cos 2 \theta$


বা, $1-\cos 2 \theta-2=\cos 2 \theta$


বা, $1-\cos 2 \theta-2-\cos 2 \theta=0$


বা, $-1-2 \cos 2 \theta=0$


বা, $2 \cos 2 \theta=-1$


বা, $\cos 2 \theta=-\frac{1}{2}$


বা, $\cos 2 \theta=\cos \frac{2 \pi}{3}$ বা, $2 \theta=2 n \pi \pm \frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$\therefore \theta=\mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}$


এখন, $\mathrm{n}=0$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{\pi}{3},-\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\mathrm{n}=1 \quad$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{4 \pi}{3}, \frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$\mathrm{n}=-1$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{-2 \pi}{3}, \frac{-4 \pi}{3}$


$\mathrm{n}=2$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{7 \pi}{3}, \frac{5 \pi}{3}$


$\mathrm{n}=-2$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{-5 \pi}{3}, \frac{-7 \pi}{3}$


$\therefore-2 \pi \leq \theta \leq 2 \pi$ ব্যবধিতে $\theta$ এর গ্রহণযোগ্য মানসমূহ :


$\frac{-5 \pi}{3}, \frac{-4 \pi}{3}, \frac{-2 \pi}{3}, \frac{-\pi}{3}, \frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{2 \pi}{3}, \frac{4 \pi}{3}, \frac{5 \pi}{3}$


নির্ণেয় সমাধান : $\frac{-5 \pi}{3}, \frac{-4 \pi}{3}, \frac{-2 \pi}{3}, \frac{-\pi}{3}, \frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{2 \pi}{3}, \frac{4 \pi}{3}, \frac{5 \pi}{3}$.

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\tan \{2 \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})\}=2 \tan \left\{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+\mathrm{f}\left(\mathrm{x}^{3}\right)\right\}$.
questions.answer:
দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে পাই,


$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{y}) & =\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{y} \\ \therefore \quad \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x}) & =\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}, \mathrm{f}\left(\mathrm{x}^{3}\right)=\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}^{3}\end{aligned}$


বামপক্ষ $=\tan \{2 \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})\}$


$=\tan \left\{2 \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}\right\}=\tan \left(\tan ^{-1} \frac{2 \mathrm{x}}{1-\mathrm{x}^{2}}\right)=\frac{2 \mathrm{x}}{1-\mathrm{x}^{2}}$


ডানপক্ষ $=2 \tan \left\{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+\mathrm{f}\left(\mathrm{x}^{3}\right)\right\}$


$=2 \tan \left(\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}+\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}^{3}\right)$


$=2 \tan \left\{\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{x+x^{3}}{1-x \cdot x^{3}}\right)\right\}$


$=2\left(\frac{\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{x}^{3}}{1-\mathrm{x}^{4}}\right)=\frac{2 \mathrm{x}\left(1+\mathrm{x}^{2}\right)}{\left(1+\mathrm{x}^{2}\right)\left(1-\mathrm{x}^{2}\right)}=\frac{2 \mathrm{x}}{1-\mathrm{x}^{2}}$


$\therefore \quad$ বামপক্ষ $=$ ডানপক্ষ


$\therefore \tan \{2 \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})\}=2 \tan \left\{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+\mathrm{f}\left(\mathrm{x}^{3}\right)\right\}$ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question:
$\tan ^{-1} x+\tan ^{-1} y=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে দেখাও যে, $x=\frac{1}{y}$.


[যেখানে, $x>0, y>0,0<x y<1$ ]
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\tan ^{-1} x+\tan ^{-1} y=\frac{\pi}{2}$


বা, $\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{x+y}{1-x y}\right)=\frac{\pi}{2}$


বা, $\frac{x+y}{1-x y}=\tan \frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{1}{0}$ বা, $1-x y=0$ বা, $x y=1$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}=\frac{1}{\mathrm{y}}$ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: যদি $f^{-1}(2 x)+f^{-1}(2 y)=\frac{3 \pi}{2}$ হলে দেখাও যে, $x^{2}+y^{2}=\frac{1}{4}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$f(x)=\cos x$


$\therefore \mathrm{f}^{-1}(x)=\cos ^{-1} x$


$\mathrm{f}^{-1}(2 x)=\cos ^{-1} 2 x$


$\mathrm{f}^{-1}(2 \mathrm{y})=\cos ^{-1} 2 \mathrm{y}$


এখন, $\mathrm{f}^{-1}(2 \mathrm{x})+\mathrm{f}^{-1}(2 \mathrm{y})=\frac{3 \pi}{2}$ হলে,


$\cos ^{-1}(2 x)+\cos ^{-1}(2 y)=\frac{3 \pi}{2}$


বা, $\cos ^{-1}(2 y)=\frac{3 \pi}{2}-\cos ^{-1}(2 x)$


বা, $2 y=\cos \left\{\frac{3 \square}{2}-\cos ^{-1}(2 x)\right\}$


$=\sin \left(\cos ^{-1} 2 \mathrm{x}\right)$


বা, $2 y=\sqrt{1-\cos ^{2}\left(\cos ^{-1} 2 \mathrm{x}\right)} \quad\left[\because \sin \theta=\sqrt{1-\cos ^{2} \theta}\right]$


বা, $2 \mathrm{y}=\sqrt{1-(2 \mathrm{x})^{2}}$


বা, $2 \mathrm{y}=\sqrt{1-4 \mathrm{x}^{2}}$


বা, $4 \mathrm{y}^{2}=1-4 \mathrm{x}^{2}$ [বর্গ করে]


বা, $4 x^{2}+4 y^{2}=1$ বা, $4\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)=1$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}^{2}+\mathrm{y}^{2}=\frac{1}{4}$ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: $f(x)+\sqrt{3} f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)=\sqrt{2}$ হলে সমীকরণ জোটটির সমাধান কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(\mathrm{x})=\cos \mathrm{x}$


$\therefore f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{x}\right)=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{x}\right)=\sin \mathrm{x}$


এখন, $f(\mathrm{x})+\sqrt{3} \mathrm{f}\left(\frac{\square}{2}-\mathrm{x}\right)=\sqrt{2}$ হলে,


$\cos x+\sqrt{3} \sin x=\sqrt{2}$


বা, $\frac{1}{2} \cos x+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \sin x=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$


 [উভয়পক্ষকে $\sqrt{1^{2}+(\sqrt{3})^{2}}=2 $ দ্বারা ভাগ করে]


বা, $\cos \frac{\pi}{3} \cos x+\sin \frac{\pi}{3} \sin x=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$


বা, $\cos \left(x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=\cos \frac{\pi}{4}$


বা, $\mathrm{x}-\frac{\pi}{3}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{4}$ যেখানে $\mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{z}$


বা, $\mathrm{x}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\pi}{3}$


বা, $x=2 n \pi+\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\pi}{3}, 2 n \pi-\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\pi}{3}$ এখানে, $n \in z$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{7 \pi}{12}, 2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{12}$


নির্ণেয় সমাধান : $\mathrm{x}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{7 \pi}{12}, 2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{12}$


যেখানে $\mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{z}$

questions.question: cos2θ + sinθ = 1 এর সাধারণ সমাধান বের কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$\cos 2 \theta+\sin \theta=1$


$\Rightarrow \sin \theta=1-\cos 2 \theta$


$ \Rightarrow \sin \theta=2 \sin ^{2} \theta $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \sin ^{2} \theta-\sin \theta=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \sin \theta(2 \sin \theta-1)=0 $


$ \therefore \sin \theta=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \theta=\mathrm{n} \pi, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z} $


$or, 2 \sin \theta-1=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \sin \theta=\frac{1}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow \sin \theta=\sin \frac{\pi}{6} $


$ \Rightarrow \theta=\mathrm{n} \pi+(-1)^{\mathrm{n}} \frac{\pi}{6}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z} $

questions.question: উদ্দীপকের আলোকে $\sqrt{3} \mathrm{~g}(\theta)+\mathrm{g}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)=1$ সমীকরণটি সমাধান কর। যখন $0<\theta<2 \pi$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})=\cos \mathrm{x}$


$\therefore \mathrm{g}(\theta)=\cos \theta$


$\therefore \mathrm{g}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)=\sin \theta$


এখন, $\sqrt{3} g(\theta)+g\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)=1,0<\theta<2 \pi$


$\Rightarrow \sqrt{3} \cos \theta+\sin \theta=1$


$\Rightarrow \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cos \theta+\frac{1}{2} \sin \theta=\frac{1}{2} \quad$ [2 দ্বারা ভাগ করে]


$\Rightarrow \cos \theta \cdot \cos \frac{\pi}{6}+\sin \theta \cdot \sin \frac{\pi}{6}=\frac{1}{2}$


$\Rightarrow \cos \left(\theta-\frac{\pi}{6}\right)=\cos \frac{\pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow \theta-\frac{\pi}{6}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


(+ve),


$\theta-\frac{\pi}{6}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow \theta=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}+\frac{\pi}{6}$


$\Rightarrow \theta=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{3 \pi}{6}$


$\Rightarrow \theta=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{2}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


(-ve),


$\theta-\frac{\pi}{6}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow \theta=2 \mathrm{n} \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}+\frac{\pi}{6}$


$\Rightarrow \theta=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{-2 \pi+\pi}{6}$


$\Rightarrow \theta=2 \mathrm{n} \pi-\frac{\pi}{6}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


$\mathrm{n}=0$ হলে, $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}, \theta=-\frac{\pi}{6}$


$\mathrm{n}=1$ হলে, $\theta=2 \pi+\frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{5 \pi}{2}, \theta=2 \pi-\frac{\pi}{6}=\frac{11 \pi}{6}$


প্রদত্ত সীমার মধ্যে $\theta$ এর মান সমূহ: $\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{11 \pi}{6}$

questions.question: $\mathrm{g}\{\pi \mathrm{h}(\theta)\}=\mathrm{h}\{\pi \mathrm{g}(\theta)\}$ হলে দেখাও যে, $\theta= \pm \frac{\pi}{4}+$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})=\cos \mathrm{x}$


$\therefore \mathrm{g}(\theta)=\cos \theta$


$\mathrm{h}(\mathrm{x})=\sin \mathrm{x}$


$\therefore \mathrm{h}(\theta)=\sin \theta$


$\therefore \mathrm{g}\{\pi \mathrm{h}(\theta)\}=\cos (\pi \sin \theta)$

 

এবং $h\{\pi g(\theta)\}=\sin (\pi \cos \theta)$


﻿﻿﻿﻿


$\begin{aligned} & \text { এখন, } \cos (\pi \sin \theta)=\sin (\pi \cos \theta) \\ & \Rightarrow \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi \sin \theta\right)=\sin (\pi \cos \theta) \\ & \Rightarrow \pi \cos \theta=\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi \sin \theta \\ & \Rightarrow \cos \theta \pm \sin \theta=\frac{1}{2} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cos \theta \pm \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \sin \theta=\frac{1}{2 \sqrt{2}} \quad[\sqrt{2} \text { দ্বারা ভাগ করে }] \\ & \Rightarrow \cos \theta \cdot \cos \frac{\pi}{4} \pm \sin \theta \cdot \sin \frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{1}{2 \sqrt{2}} \\ & \Rightarrow \cos \left(\theta \pm \frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\frac{1}{2 \sqrt{2}} \\ & \Rightarrow \theta \pm \frac{\pi}{4}=\cos ^{-1} \frac{1}{2 \sqrt{2}} \\ & \Rightarrow \theta= \pm \frac{\pi}{4}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{1}{2 \sqrt{2}} \\ & \Rightarrow \theta= \pm \frac{\pi}{4}+\tan ^{-1} \sqrt{7} \text { (দেখানো হলো) }\end{aligned}$

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর: cot–1(tan2φ) + cot–1(–tan3φ) = φ
questions.answer:
$L.H.S =\cot ^{-1}(\tan 2 \varphi)+\cot ^{-1}(-\tan 3 \varphi) $


$ =\cot ^{-1}\left\{\cot \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \varphi\right)\right\}-\cot ^{-1}\left\{\cot \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-3 \varphi\right)\right\} $


$ =\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \varphi-\frac{\pi}{2}-3 \varphi $


$ =\varphi $


$ =\text { RHS } $

questions.question: উদ্দীপকের আলোকে সমাধান কর: $(2+\sqrt{3}) f(2 \theta)=1-f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta\right).$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ f(x)=\cos x $


$ \therefore f(2 \theta)=\cos 2 \theta $


$ \therefore f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta\right)=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta\right)=\sin 2 \theta $


এখন, $ (2+\sqrt{3}) f(2 \theta)=1-f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta\right) $


$ \Rightarrow(2+\sqrt{3}) \cos 2 \theta=1-\sin 2 \theta $


$ \Rightarrow(2+\sqrt{3})\left(\cos ^{2} \theta-\sin ^{2} \theta\right)=\cos ^{2} \theta+\sin ^{2} \theta-2 \sin \theta \cos \theta $


$ \Rightarrow(2+\sqrt{3})\left(\cos ^{2} \theta-\sin ^{2} \theta\right)-(\cos \theta-\sin \theta)^{2}=0 $


$ \Rightarrow(\cos \theta-\sin \theta)\{(2+\sqrt{3})(\cos \theta-\sin \theta)-(\cos \theta-\sin \theta)\}=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \sin \theta=\cos \theta $


$ \Rightarrow \tan \theta=\tan \frac{\pi}{4} $


$ \therefore \theta=\mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{4}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z} $


অথবা, $ (2+\sqrt{3})(\cos \theta-\sin \theta)-(\cos \theta-\sin \theta)=0 $


$ \Rightarrow(2+\sqrt{3})(\cos \theta-\sin \theta)=(\cos \theta-\sin \theta) $


$ \Rightarrow \frac{\cos \theta-\sin \theta}{\cos \theta-\sin \theta}=\frac{1}{2+\sqrt{3}} $


$ \Rightarrow \frac{\cos \theta+\sin \theta+\cos \theta-\sin \theta}{\cos \theta+\sin \theta-\cos \theta+\sin \theta}=\frac{1+2+\sqrt{3}}{1-2-\sqrt{3}} $ [যোজন-বিয়োজন]


$\Rightarrow \frac{2 \cos \theta}{2 \sin \theta}=\frac{3+\sqrt{3}}{-1-\sqrt{3}}$


$\Rightarrow \tan \theta=\frac{\sqrt{3}(1+\sqrt{3})}{-1(1+\sqrt{3)}}$


$\Rightarrow \tan \theta=\frac{-1}{\sqrt{3}}=-\tan \frac{\pi}{6}=\tan \left(-\frac{\pi}{6}\right)$


$\therefore \theta=\mathrm{n} \pi-\frac{\pi}{6}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


নির্ণের সমাধান: $\theta=n \pi+\frac{\pi}{4}, n \pi-\frac{\pi}{6}, n \in Z$

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $ 2 \mathrm{~h}\left(\frac{\sqrt{a-b}}{\sqrt{a+b}} \tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right)=\cos ^{-1} \frac{b+a f(\theta)}{a+b f(\theta)} $
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(\mathrm{x})=\cos \mathrm{x}$


এবং $\mathrm{h}(\mathrm{x})=\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}$


$\therefore \mathrm{h}\left(\frac{\sqrt{a-b}}{\sqrt{a+b}} \tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right)=\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{a-b}}{\sqrt{a+b}} \tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right)$


L.H.S $=2 \mathrm{~h}\left(\frac{\sqrt{a-b}}{\sqrt{a+b}} \tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right)$


$=2 \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{a-b}}{\sqrt{a+b}} \tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right)$


$=\cos ^{-1}\left(\frac{1-\frac{a-b}{a+b} \tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}{1+\frac{a-b}{a+b} \tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}\right)$


$=\cos ^{-1}\left(\frac{a+b-(a-b) \tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}{a+b+(a-b) \tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}\right) \quad[(\mathrm{a}+\mathrm{b})$ দ্বারা ভাগ করে]


$=\cos ^{-1} \frac{a+b-a \tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}+b \tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}{a+b-\operatorname{atan}^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}-b \tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}$


$=\cos ^{-1} \frac{a\left(1-\tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}\right)+b\left(1+\tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}\right)}{a\left(1-\tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}\right)+b\left(1-\tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}\right)}$


$=\cos ^{-1} \frac{a\left(\frac{1-\tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}\right)+b}{a+b\left(\frac{1-\tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}\right)}\left[1+\tan ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}\right.$ দ্বারা ভাগ করে]


$=\cos ^{-1} \frac{a \cos \theta+b}{a+b \cos \theta}$


$=\cos ^{-1} \frac{b+a f(\theta)}{a+b f(\theta)}$


$=$ RHS (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $f\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)+f\left(\frac{1}{5}\right)$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(\mathrm{a})=\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{a}$


এখন,


$f\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)+f\left(\frac{1}{5}\right) =\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)+\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{5}\right) $


$ =\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\frac{1}{3}+\frac{1}{5}}{1-\frac{1}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{5}}\right) $


$ =\tan ^{-1}\left(\underline{\frac{8}{15}}\right) $


$ =\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{8}{14}\right) $


$ =\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{4}{7}\right) $

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $2 f\left(\sqrt{\frac{x-y}{x+y}} \tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right)=\sec ^{-1} \frac{x+y g\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)}{y+x g\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ f(\mathrm{a})=\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{a}, \mathrm{g}(\mathrm{a})=\sin \mathrm{a} $


$ \mathrm{LHS}=2 f\left(\sqrt{\frac{x-y}{x+y}} \tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right) $


$ =2 \tan ^{-1}\left(\sqrt{\frac{x-y}{x+y}} \tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right) $


$ =\sec ^{-1}\left(\frac{1+\frac{x-y}{x+y} \tan \frac{\theta}{2}}{1-\frac{x-y}{x+y} \tan \frac{\theta}{2}}\right) $


$ =\sec ^{-1}\left(\frac{x+y+(x-y) \tan \frac{\theta}{2}}{x+y-(x-y) \tan \frac{\theta}{2}}\right) $


$ =\sec ^{-1}\left(\frac{x\left(1+\tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right)+y\left(1-\tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right)}{x\left(1-\tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right)+y\left(1+\tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right)}\right) $


$ =\sec ^{-1}\left(\frac{x\left(\frac{1+\tan \frac{\theta}{2}}{1+\tan \frac{\theta}{2}}\right)+y\left(\frac{1-\tan \frac{\theta}{2}}{1+\tan \frac{\theta}{2}}\right)}{x\left(\frac{1-\tan \frac{\theta}{2}}{1+\tan \frac{\theta}{2}}\right)+y\left(\frac{1+\tan \frac{\theta}{2}}{1+\tan \frac{\theta}{2}}\right)}\right. $


$ =\sec ^{-1}\left(\frac{x+y \cos \theta}{x \cos \theta+y}\right) $


$ =\sec ^{-1}\left(\frac{x+y\left(\sin \frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)}{y+x\left(\sin \frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)}\right) $


$ =\sec ^{-1} \frac{x+y g\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)}{y+x g\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)} $


$ \text { = RHS }$ (দেখানো হল)

questions.question: সমাধান কর: $\mathrm{g}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)+\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{a})=\sin \mathrm{a}$


$\therefore \mathrm{g}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)+\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$.


$\Rightarrow \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)+\sin (\mathrm{x})=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$.


$\Rightarrow \cos \mathrm{x}+\sin \mathrm{x}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$


$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cos x+\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \sin x=\frac{1}{2}$ [2 দ্বারা ভাগ করে]


$\Rightarrow \cos x \cdot \cos \frac{\pi}{4}+\sin x \cdot \sin \frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{1}{2}$


$\Rightarrow \cos \left(\mathrm{x}-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\cos \frac{\pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}-\frac{\pi}{4}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


(+ve),


$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}-\frac{\pi}{4}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}+\frac{\pi}{4}$


$=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{7 \pi}{12}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


$(-\mathrm{ve})$,


$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}-\frac{\pi}{4}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}-\frac{\pi}{4}$


$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi-\frac{\pi}{12}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


নির্ণেয় সমাধান: $\mathrm{x}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{7 \pi}{12}, 2 \mathrm{n} \pi-\frac{\pi}{12}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$

questions.question: $f\left(\pi f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\right)=f\left(\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi f(\theta)\right)$ रলে, দেখাও যে, $\theta= \pm \frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$f(x)=\sin x$


$\therefore f\left(\pi f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\right)=f\left(\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi f(\theta)\right)$


$\Rightarrow f\left(\pi \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\right)=f\left(\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi \sin \theta\right)$


$\Rightarrow f(\pi \cos \theta)=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi \sin \theta\right)$


$\Rightarrow \sin (\pi \cos \theta)=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi \sin \theta\right)$


$\Rightarrow \pi \cos \theta=\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi \sin \theta$


$\Rightarrow \cos \theta=\frac{1}{2} \pm \sin \theta$


$\Rightarrow(\cos \theta \pm \sin \theta)^{2}=\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2}$


$\Rightarrow \cos ^{2} \theta+\sin ^{2} \theta \pm 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta=\frac{1}{4}$


$\Rightarrow 1 \pm \sin 2 \theta=\frac{1}{4}$


$\Rightarrow \pm \sin 2 \theta=\frac{1}{4}-1=-\frac{3}{4}$


$\Rightarrow \sin 2 \theta= \pm \frac{3}{4}$


$\Rightarrow 2 \theta=\sin ^{-1}\left( \pm \frac{3}{4}\right)= \pm \sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{4}\right)$


$\therefore \theta= \pm \frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{4}\right)$ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: সমাধান কর: $1+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-4 x\right)+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-6 x\right)=0$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$f(\mathrm{x})=\sin \mathrm{x}$


$ \therefore 1+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-4 x\right)+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-6 x\right)=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 1+\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)+\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-4 x\right)+\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-6 x\right)=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 1+\cos 2 x+\cos 4 x+\cos 6 x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \cos 4 x+\cos 2 x+(1+\cos 6 x)=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \cos 3 x \cos x+2 \cos ^{2} 3 x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \cos 3 x(\cos x+\cos 3 x)=0 $


$ \therefore \cos 3 x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 3 x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2} $


$ \therefore x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{6}, n \in Z $


অথবা, $ \cos x+\cos 3 x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \cos 2 x \cos x=0 $


$ \therefore \cos 2 x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2} $


$ \therefore x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4}, n \in Z $


অথবা, $ \cos x=0 $


$ \therefore x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2}, n \in Z $


নির্ণের সমাধান: $x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2},(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4},(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{6} \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\begin{aligned}& \sin ^{-1}(\sqrt{2} f(\theta))+\sin ^{-1}\left(\sqrt{f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta\right)}\right) \\& =\frac{\pi}{2}\end{aligned}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=\sin x$

questions.question: সমাধান করঃ $ f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)+f(\theta)=f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta\right)+f(2 \theta)$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$f(x)=\sin x$


$\therefore f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)+f(\theta)=f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta\right)+f(2 \theta)$


$\Rightarrow \cos \theta+\sin \theta=\cos 2 \theta+\sin 2 \theta$


$\Rightarrow \cos \theta-\cos 2 \theta=\sin 2 \theta-\sin \theta$


$\Rightarrow 2 \sin \frac{3 \theta}{2} \sin \frac{\theta}{2}=2 \cos \frac{3 \theta}{2} \sin \frac{\theta}{2}$


$\Rightarrow \sin \frac{\theta}{2}\left(\sin \frac{3 \theta}{2}-\cos \frac{3 \theta}{2}\right)=0$


এখন


$\therefore \sin \frac{\theta}{2}=0$


$ \Rightarrow \frac{\theta}{2}=n \pi $


$ \Rightarrow \theta=2 n \pi, n \in Z $


অথবা,


$\begin{aligned}& \operatorname{Sin} \frac{3 \theta}{2}-\cos \frac{3 \theta}{2}=0 \\& \Rightarrow \sin \frac{3 \theta}{2}=\cos \frac{3 \theta}{2} \\& \Rightarrow \tan \frac{3 \theta}{2}=1 \\& \Rightarrow \frac{3 \theta}{2}=(4 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4} \\& \Rightarrow \theta=(4 n+1) \frac{\pi}{6}, n \in Z\end{aligned}$


নির্ণেয় সমাধানঃ $\theta=2 n \pi,(4 n+1) \frac{\pi}{6}, n \in Z$

questions.question: $\sin ^{-1} x+\sin ^{-1} y=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে, দেখাও যে, $x^{2}+y^{2}=1$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\sin ^{-1} x+\sin ^{-1} y=\frac{\pi}{2}$


$ \Rightarrow \sin ^{-1} x=\frac{\pi}{2}-\sin ^{-1} y $


$ \Rightarrow x=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\sin ^{-1} y\right) $


$ \Rightarrow x=\cos \sin ^{-1} y $


$ \Rightarrow x=\cos \cos ^{-1} \sqrt{1-y^{2}} $


$ \therefore x^{2}+y^{2}=1 \quad $ (দেখানো হল)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এ $\angle A C B=2 x$ হলে, $\cot ^{-1} 3-x$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\angle A C B=2 x$


$ \Rightarrow 2 x=\pi-\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\angle B A C\right) $


$ \Rightarrow 2 x=\frac{\pi}{2}-\cot ^{-1} \frac{3}{4} $


$ \Rightarrow x=\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{1}{2} \cot ^{-1} \frac{3}{4} $


এখন,


$\begin{aligned}& \cot ^{-1} 3-x \\& =\cot ^{-1} 3-\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{1}{2} \cot ^{-1} \frac{3}{4} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{3}+\frac{1}{2} \cot ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}-\frac{\pi}{4} \\& =\frac{1}{2} 2 \tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{3}+\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \frac{4}{3}-\frac{\pi}{4} \\& =\frac{1}{2}\left(\tan ^{-1} \frac{\frac{2}{3}}{1-\frac{1}{9}}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{4}{3}\right)-\frac{\pi}{4} \\& =\frac{1}{2}\left(\tan ^{-1} \frac{6}{8}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{4}{3}\right)-\frac{\pi}{4} \\& =\frac{1}{2}\left(\tan ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}+\cot ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}\right)-\frac{\pi}{4} \\& =\frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{\pi}{4}\left[\because \tan ^{-1} x+\cot ^{-1} x=\frac{\pi}{2}\right] \\& =\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\pi}{4}=0\end{aligned}$

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ এর সমীকরণটি $0<x<\pi$ ব্যাবধিতে সমাধান কর।
questions.answer:
দৃশ্যকল্প-২হতে পাই,

$\begin{aligned}& 4 \cdot \cos x \cdot \cos 2 x \cdot \cos 3 x=1 \\& 2 \cos 2 x \cdot 2 \cos 3 x \cdot \cos x=1 \\& 2 \cos 2 \cdot(\cos 4 x+\cos 2 x)=1 \\& 2 \cos 4 x \cdot \cos 2 x+\cos ^{2} x-1=0 \\& 2 \cos 4 x \cdot \cos 2 x+\cos 4 x=0 \\& \cos 4 x(2 \cos 2 x+1)=0 \end{aligned}$


এখন,


$\begin{aligned}& \cos 4 x=0 \\& \Rightarrow 4 x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2} \\& \Rightarrow x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{8}, n \in Z\end{aligned}$


অথবা,


$(2 \cos 2 x+1)=0$


$\Rightarrow \cos 2 x=-\frac{1}{2}=\cos \frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow 2 x=2 n \pi \pm \frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow x=n \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, n \in Z$


$\therefore x=n \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}, x=n \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\therefore n=0$ হলে, $x=\frac{\pi}{8}, x=\frac{\pi}{3}, x=-\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\therefore n=1$ হলে, $x=\frac{3 \pi}{8}, x=\pi+\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{4 \pi}{3}$,


$x=\pi-\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$\therefore n=2$ হলে $x=\frac{5 \pi}{8}, x=2 \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{7 \pi}{3}$,


$x=2 \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{5 \pi}{3}$


$\therefore n=3$ হলে $x=\frac{7 \pi}{8}, x=3 \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}$,


$x=3 \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}$


নির্ণেয় মানসমূহঃ $\frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{\pi}{8}, \frac{3 \pi}{8}, \frac{2 \pi}{3}, \frac{5 \pi}{8}, \frac{7 \pi}{8}$

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এর আলোকে, $2 f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right) \cdot f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-3 \theta\right)+1=0$ সমীকরণের সমাধান কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(\theta)=\sin \theta$


প্রদত্ত সমীকরণ,


$ 2 f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right) \cdot f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-3 \theta\right)+1=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \cos \theta \cdot \cos 3 \theta+1=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \cos (3 \theta+\theta)+\cos (3 \theta-\theta)+1=0 $


$\begin{aligned}& \Rightarrow \cos 4 \theta+\cos 2 \theta+1=0 \\& \Rightarrow 2 \cos ^{2} 2 \theta+\cos 2 \theta=0 \\& \Rightarrow \cos 2 \theta(2 \cos 2 \theta+1)=0 \\& \therefore \cos 2 \theta=0 \\& \Rightarrow 2 \theta=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2} \\& \Rightarrow \theta=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4}, n \epsilon Z\end{aligned}$


অথবা, $\cos 2 \theta=-\frac{1}{2}=\cos \frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$\begin{aligned}& \Rightarrow 2 \theta=2 n \pi \pm \frac{2 \pi}{3} \\& \therefore \theta=n \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, n \in Z\end{aligned}$


$\therefore$ নির্ণেয় সমাধানঃ $x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4}, n \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, n \in Z$

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ থেকে দেখাও যে, $A=\tan ^{-1} \frac{11}{27}$
questions.answer:
দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে,

$\begin{aligned}& A=\operatorname{cosec}^{-1} \sqrt{5}-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5} \\ &+\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{4}\end{aligned}$


ধরি $\quad \frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}=\theta$


$\begin{aligned}& \Rightarrow \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}=2 \theta \\& \Rightarrow \sin 2 \theta=\frac{3}{5}\end{aligned}$


$\begin{aligned}\therefore \tan \theta & =\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} \\& =\frac{2 \sin \theta \cdot \sin \theta}{2 \sin \theta \cdot \cos \theta}\end{aligned}$


$\begin{aligned}& =\frac{2 \sin ^{2} \theta}{\sin 2 \theta} \\& =\frac{1-\cos 2 \theta}{\sin 2 \theta} \\& =\frac{1-\sqrt{1-\sin ^{2} 2 \theta}}{\sin 2 \theta} \\& =\frac{1-\sqrt{1-\frac{9}{25}}}{\frac{3}{5}} \\& =\frac{1-\frac{4}{5}}{\frac{3}{5}} \\& =\frac{\frac{1}{5}}{\frac{3}{5}} \\& =\frac{1}{3} \\& \therefore \theta=\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{3} \\& \therefore A=\operatorname{cosec}^{-1} \sqrt{5}-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5} \\ & +\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{4} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{2}-\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{3}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{4} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{3}}{1+\frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{3}}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{4} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{\frac{1}{6}}{\frac{7}{6}}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{4} \\ & =\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{7}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{4} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{\frac{1}{7}+\frac{1}{4}}{1-\frac{1}{7} \cdot \frac{1}{4}} \\& =\tan ^{-1} \frac{11}{27} \end{aligned}$


$= R.H.S$ (দেখানো হল)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে, $2\{f(x)\}^{2}+5 f(x)-3=0$ সমীকরণটির সমাধান কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=\sin x$


$\begin{aligned}& \therefore 2\{f(x)\}^{2}+5 f(x)-3=0 \\& \Rightarrow 2 \sin ^{2} x+5 \sin x-3=0 \\& \Rightarrow 2 \sin ^{2} x+6 \sin x-\sin x-3=0 \\& \Rightarrow 2 \sin x(\sin x+3)-1(\sin x+3)=0 \\& \Rightarrow(\sin x+3)(2 \sin x-1)=0\end{aligned}$


$\therefore \sin x=-3$


এখানে,


$\sin x=-3$ (গ্রহণযোগ্য নয়)


অথবা,

$\therefore 2 \sin x=1$


$\Rightarrow \sin x=\frac{1}{2}=\sin \frac{\pi}{6}$


$\Rightarrow x=n \pi+(-1)^{n} \frac{\pi}{6}, n \in Z$


নির্ণেয় সমাধানঃ $x=n \pi+(-1)^{n} \frac{\pi}{6}, n \in Z$

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\operatorname{cosec}^{2}\left(\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{2}\right)-3 \sec ^{2}\left(\cot ^{-1} \sqrt{3}\right)=1$.
questions.answer:
$ LH.S =\operatorname{cosec}^{2}\left(\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{2}\right)-3 \sec ^{2}\left(\cot ^{-1} \sqrt{3}\right) $


$ =1+\cot ^{2}\left(\cot ^{-1} 2\right)-3\left\{1+\tan ^{2}\left(\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)\right\} $


$ =1+4-3-3 \cdot \frac{1}{3} $


$ =1 $


= R.H.S

questions.question: $f(\pi g(x))=\mathbf{g}(\pi f(x))$ হলে দেখাও যে, $x= \pm \frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\sin \mathrm{x}$


$\therefore \mathrm{f}(\pi \mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x}))=\mathrm{g}(\pi \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x}))=\cos \mathrm{x}$


$\Rightarrow \sin (\pi \cos x)=\cos (\pi \sin x)$


$\Rightarrow \sin (\pi \cos x)=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi \sin x\right)$


$\Rightarrow \pi \cos x=\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi \sin x$


$\Rightarrow \cos x=\frac{1}{2} \pm \sin x$


$\Rightarrow \cos x \pm \sin x=\frac{1}{2}$


$\Rightarrow \cos x+\sin ^{2} x \pm 2 \sin x \cos x=\frac{1}{4}$


$\Rightarrow \pm \sin 2 x=1-\frac{1}{4}=\frac{3}{4}$


$\Rightarrow \sin 2 x= \pm \frac{3}{4}$


$\Rightarrow 2 \mathrm{x} \pm \sin ^{-1}\left( \pm \frac{3}{4}\right)= \pm \sin \left(\frac{3}{4}\right)$


$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}= \pm \frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{4}\right)$ (দেখানো হল)

questions.question: উদ্দীপকের আলোকে প্রমাণ কর যে, 2A + B = 2(C + D).
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ A=\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}, B=\cos ^{-1} \frac{5}{13}, C=\cot ^{-1} 2, D=\tan ^{-1} \frac{28}{29} $


$ \therefore L H S=2 A+B $


$ =2 \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{5}{13} $


$ =2 \tan ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{12}{5} $


$ =\tan ^{-1} \frac{2 \cdot \frac{3}{4}}{1-\frac{9}{16}}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{12}{5} $


$ =\tan ^{-1} \frac{24}{7}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{12}{5}$


$ =\tan ^{-1} \frac{24 / 7+12 / 5}{1-\frac{24}{7} \cdot \frac{12}{5}} $


$ =\tan ^{-1} \frac{\frac{120+84}{35}}{\frac{-253}{35}} $


$ =\tan ^{-1} \frac{204}{-253} $


$ \therefore \mathrm{R} \cdot \mathrm{H} \cdot \mathrm{S}=2(\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{D}) $


$ =2\left(\cot ^{-1} 2+\tan ^{-1} \frac{28}{29}\right) $


$ =2\left(\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{2}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{28}{29}\right) $


$ =2 \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\frac{1}{2}+\frac{28}{29}}{1-\frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{28}{29}}\right) $


$ =2 \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\frac{85}{58}}{30}\right)^{4} $


$ =2 \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{17}{6}\right) $


$ =\tan ^{-1} \frac{2 \cdot \frac{17}{6}}{1-\left(\frac{17}{6}\right)^{2}} $


$ =\tan ^{-1}\left(-\frac{204}{253}\right) $


$ \therefore \mathrm{LH} \cdot \mathrm{S}=\mathrm{R} \cdot \mathrm{H} \cdot \mathrm{S} $

questions.question: সমাধান কর: $\tan ^{2} \theta-3 \operatorname{cosec}^{2} \theta+1=0$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ \tan ^{2} \theta-3 \operatorname{cosec}^{2} \theta+1=0 $


$\Rightarrow \tan ^{2} \theta-3\left(1+\cot ^{2} \theta\right)+1=0 $


$\Rightarrow \tan ^{2} \theta-3-3 \cot ^{2} \theta+1=0 $


$\Rightarrow \tan ^{2} \theta-3 \frac{1}{\tan ^{2} \theta}-2=0 $


$\Rightarrow \tan ^{4} \theta-3-2 \tan ^{2} \theta=0 $


$\Rightarrow \left(\tan ^{2} \theta\right)^{2}-2 \cdot \tan ^{2} \theta+1^{2}-4=0 $


$\Rightarrow \left(\tan ^{2} \theta-1\right)^{2}=4 $


$\Rightarrow \tan ^{2} \theta-1=2 $


$\Rightarrow \tan ^{2} \theta=3 $


$\Rightarrow \tan ^{2}= \pm \sqrt{3}= \pm \tan \frac{\pi}{3}=\tan \left( \pm \frac{\pi}{3}\right) $


$\Rightarrow \theta=n \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, n \in z $

questions.question: $a=\sqrt{3}$ এবং $b=1$ হলে দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এর সমীকরণটি সমাধান কর, যেখানে $-2 \pi<x<2 \pi$.
questions.answer:
দৃশ্যকল্প-১ হতে পাই,


$ a \sin x+b \cos x=1 $


$ a=\sqrt{3} \text { এবং } b=1 $ হলে,


$ \therefore \sqrt{3} \sin x+\cos x=1 ;-2 \pi<x<2 \pi $


$[\sqrt{(\sqrt{3})^{2}+1^{2}}$ $=2$ দ্বারা উভয়পক্ষকে ভাগ]


$ \Rightarrow \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \sin x+\frac{1}{2} \cos x=\frac{1}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow \cos x \cos \frac{\pi}{3}+\sin x \sin \frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{1}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow \cos \left(x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=\cos \frac{\pi}{3} $


$ \Rightarrow x-\frac{\pi}{3}=2 n \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, n \in z $


(+ve) চিহ্ন নিয়ে, $\mathrm{x}==2 n \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}+\frac{\pi}{3}$


$=2 n \pi+\frac{2 \pi}{3}, n \in Z$


(-ve) চিহ্ন নিয়ে, $\mathrm{x}=2 n \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}+\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\mathrm{n}=0$ হলে, $\mathrm{x}=\frac{2 \pi}{3}, \mathrm{x}=0$


$\mathrm{n}=1$ হলে, $\mathrm{x}=2 \pi+\frac{2 \pi}{3}, \mathrm{x}=2 \pi$


$\mathrm{n}=-1$ হলে, $\mathrm{x}=-2 \pi+\frac{2 \pi}{3}, \mathrm{x}=-2 \pi$


$\therefore$ নির্ণেয় $x$ এর মান সমূহ:


$=\frac{-4 \pi}{3}$


$0, \frac{2 \pi}{3}, \frac{-4 \pi}{3}$

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ এর আলোকে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+\mathrm{f}(3 \mathrm{x})+\mathrm{f}(5 \mathrm{x})+\mathrm{f}(7 \mathrm{x})$ সমীকরণটি সমাধান কর, যেখানে $0<\mathrm{x}<\pi$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=\cos x$


$ \therefore f(x)+f(3 x)+f(5 x)+f(7 x)=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \cos x+\cos 3 x+\cos 5 x+\cos 7 x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow(\cos 7 x+\cos x)+(\cos 5 x+\cos 3 x)=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \cos 4 x \cdot \cos 3 x+2 \cos 4 x \cdot \cos x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \cos 4 x(\cos 3 x+\cos x)=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \cos 4 x \cdot 2 \cos 2 x \cdot \cos x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \cos x \cdot \cos 2 x \cdot \cos 4 x=0 $


$ \therefore \cos x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2}, n \in z $


অথবা, $\cos 2 x=0$


$ \Rightarrow 2 x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2} $


$ \therefore x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4}, n \in z $


অথবা, $\cos 4 x=0$


$ \Rightarrow 4 x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2} $


$ \therefore x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{8}, n \in z $


$n=0$ হলে, $x=\frac{\pi}{2}, x=\frac{\pi}{4}, x=\frac{\pi}{8}$


$x=1$ হলে, $x=\frac{3 \pi}{2}, x=\frac{3 \pi}{4}, x=\frac{3 \pi}{8}$


$x=2$ হলে, $x=\frac{5 \pi}{2}, x=\frac{5 \pi}{4}, x=\frac{5 \pi}{8}$


$x=3$ হলে, $x=\frac{7 \pi}{2}, x=\frac{7 \pi}{4}, x=\frac{7 \pi}{8}$


$\therefore$ প্রদত্ত সীমার মধ্যে $\mathrm{x}$ এর মান সমূহ: $\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{\pi}{8}, \frac{3 \pi}{4}, \frac{3 \pi}{8}, \frac{5 \pi}{8}, \frac{7 \pi}{8}$

questions.question: উদ্দীপক-১ এ $\alpha+\beta=\gamma$ হলে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\frac{x^{2}}{p^{2}}+\frac{y^{2}}{q^{2}}-\frac{2 x y}{p q} \cos \gamma=\sin ^{2} \gamma$
questions.answer:
উদ্দীপক-১ হতে পাই,


$ \sec \alpha=\frac{p}{x} $


$ \Rightarrow \alpha=\sec ^{-1} \frac{p}{x} $


$ \Rightarrow \alpha=\cos ^{-1} \frac{x}{p} $


এবং


$ \sec \beta=\frac{q}{y} $


$ \Rightarrow \beta=\sec ^{-1} \frac{q}{y} $


$ \Rightarrow \beta=\cos ^{-1} \frac{y}{q} $


প্রশ্নমতে, $\alpha+\beta=\gamma$


$\Rightarrow \cos ^{-1} \frac{x}{p}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{y}{q}=\gamma$


$\Rightarrow \cos ^{-1}\left\{\frac{x}{p} \cdot \frac{y}{q}-\sqrt{\left(1-\frac{x^{2}}{p^{2}}\right)\left(1-\frac{y^{2}}{q^{2}}\right)}\right\}=\gamma$


$\Rightarrow \frac{x}{p} \cdot \frac{y}{q}-\sqrt{\left(1-\frac{x^{2}}{p^{2}}\right)\left(1-\frac{y^{2}}{q^{2}}\right)}=\cos \gamma$


$\Rightarrow \sqrt{\left(1-\frac{x^{2}}{p^{2}}\right)\left(1-\frac{y^{2}}{q^{2}}\right)}=\left(\frac{x}{p} \cdot \frac{y}{q}-\cos \gamma\right)$


$\Rightarrow 1-\frac{x^{2}}{p^{2}}-\frac{y^{2}}{q^{2}}+\frac{x^{2}}{p^{2}} \cdot \frac{y^{2}}{q^{2}}=\frac{x^{2}}{p^{2}} \cdot \frac{y^{2}}{q^{2}}-2 \frac{x y}{p q} \cos \gamma+\cos ^{2} \gamma$


$\Rightarrow \frac{x^{2}}{p^{2}}-\frac{2 x y}{p q} \cos \gamma+\frac{y^{2}}{q^{2}}=1-\cos ^{2} \gamma=\sin ^{2} \gamma$


$\therefore \frac{x^{2}}{p^{2}}-\frac{2 x y}{p q} \cos \gamma+\frac{y^{2}}{q^{2}}=\sin ^{2} \gamma$


(দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: উদ্দীপক-২ এর আলোকে $f(x) f(3 x)+2=0$ সমীকরণের সমাধান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
উদ্দীপক-২ হতে পাই,


$ f(x)=\sec x $


$ \therefore f(x) f(3 x)+2=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \sec x \cdot \sec 3 x+2=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \frac{1}{\cos x} \cdot \frac{1}{\cos 3 x}=-2 $


$ \Rightarrow \cos x \cdot \cos 3 x=-\frac{1}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \cos 3 x \cdot \cos x+1=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \cos (3 x+x)+\cos (3 x-x)+1=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \cos 4 x+\cos 2 x+1=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \cos 22 x+\cos 2 x=0 $


$\Rightarrow \cos 2 x(2 \cos 2 x+1)=0 $


$ \therefore \cos 2 x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4}, n \in z $


অথবা, $\cos 2 x=-\frac{1}{2}=\cos \frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$ \Rightarrow 2 x=2 n \pi \pm \frac{2 \pi}{3} $


$ \therefore x=n \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, n \in Z $


$\therefore$ নির্ণেয় সমাধানঃ $x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4}, n \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, n \in Z$

context:
উদ্দীপক-১: $A=\cot ^{-1} 7, B=\cot ^{-1} 3, g(A)=\cos 2 A, h(B)=\sin 4 B$.


উদ্দীপক-২: $f(\alpha)=\cos \alpha, g(\alpha)=\sin 2 \alpha, h(\alpha)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$

questions.question: উদ্দীপক-১ এ প্রমাণ কর যে, $A=g^{-1}\{h(B)\}$
questions.answer:
উদ্দীপক-১ হতে পাই,


$ A=\cot ^{-1} 7, B=\cot ^{-1} 3, $


$ g(A)= $


$\cos 2 A, h(B)=\sin 4 B $


$\therefore g(A)=\cos 2 A=1-2 \sin ^{2} a $


$=1-2 \cdot\left\{\sin \left(\cot ^{-1} 7\right)\right\}^{2} $


$=1-2 \cdot\left(\sin \cdot \sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{50}}\right)^{2} $


$ =1-2 \cdot \frac{1}{50} $


$ =1-\frac{1}{25} $


$ =\frac{24}{25} $


এবং $h(B)=\sin 4 B$


$ =2 \sin 2 B \cdot \cos 2 B $


$ =2 \cdot 2 \sin B \cdot \cos B\left(1-2 \sin ^{2} B\right) $


$ =4\left(\sin \cdot \cot ^{-1} 3\right)\left(\operatorname{cost} \cdot \cot ^{-1} 3\right) $


$ \left\{1-2\left(\sin \cdot \cot ^{-1} 3\right)^{2}\right\} $


$ =4\left(\sin \cdot \sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\right)\left(\cos \cos ^{-1} \frac{3}{\sqrt{10}}\right) $


$ \left\{1-2\left(\sin \sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\right)^{2}\right\} $


$ =4 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{10}} \cdot \frac{3}{\sqrt{10}} \cdot\left(1-\frac{2}{10}\right) $


$=\frac{6}{5} \cdot \frac{4}{5}$


$=\frac{24}{25}$


$\therefore g(A)=h(B)$


$\Rightarrow g^{-1}\{g(A)\}=g^{-1}\{h(B)\}$


$\therefore A=g^{-1}\{h(B)\}$ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: উদ্দীপক -২ এর আলোকে সমাধান করঃ $f(\alpha)+g\left(\frac{\alpha}{2}\right)=h(\alpha)$, যখন $-2 \pi \leq \alpha \leq 2 \pi$
questions.answer:
উদ্দীপক -২হতে পাই,


$f(\alpha)=\cos \alpha, \quad g(\alpha)=\sin 2 \alpha$


এবং $h(\alpha)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$


$f(\alpha)+g\left(\frac{\alpha}{2}\right)=h(\alpha) ;-2 \pi \leq \alpha \leq 2 \pi$


$\Rightarrow \cos \alpha+\sin \alpha=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$


$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cos \alpha+\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \sin \alpha=\frac{1}{2}$ [$\sqrt{2}$ দ্বারা ভাগ করে $]$


$\Rightarrow \cos \alpha \cdot \cos \frac{\pi}{4}+\sin \alpha \cdot \sin \frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{1}{2}$


$\Rightarrow \cos \left(\alpha-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\cos \frac{\pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow \alpha-\frac{\pi}{4}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


(+ve),


$\Rightarrow \alpha-\frac{\pi}{4}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow \alpha=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}+\frac{\pi}{4}$


$=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{7 \pi}{12}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


$(-v e)$


$\Rightarrow \alpha-\frac{\pi}{4}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow \alpha=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}-\frac{\pi}{4}$


$\Rightarrow \alpha=2 \mathrm{n} \pi-\frac{\pi}{12}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


$\mathrm{n}=0$ शলে, $\alpha=\frac{7 \pi}{12}, \frac{-\pi}{12}$


$\mathrm{n}=1$ হলে, $\alpha=\frac{31 \pi}{12}, \frac{23 \pi}{12}$


$\mathrm{n}=-1$ হলে, $\alpha=\frac{-17 \pi}{12}, \frac{-25 \pi}{12}$


$\therefore \alpha=\frac{-17 \pi}{12}, \frac{-\pi}{12}, \frac{7 \pi}{12}, \frac{23 \pi}{12}$ (যখন $-2 \pi \leq \alpha \leq 2 \pi$ )


নির্ণেয় সমাধান: $\alpha=\frac{-17 \pi}{12}, \frac{-\pi}{12}, \frac{7 \pi}{12}, \frac{23 \pi}{12}$

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ হতে প্রমাণ কর যে, $P=\tan ^{-1} 2$
questions.answer:
উদ্দীপক-১ হতে,


$\begin{aligned}P & =\sec ^{-1} \sqrt{5}-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}+\cot ^{-1} 3 \\ & =\tan ^{-1} 2-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}+\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{3} \\& =\tan ^{-1} 2-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}+\frac{1}{2} \cdot \sin ^{-1} \frac{2 \cdot \frac{1}{3}}{1+\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{2}} \\& =\tan ^{-1} 2-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}+\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{2 / 3}{1+\frac{1}{9}} \\& =\tan ^{-1} 2-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}+\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{9}{10} \\& =\tan ^{-1} 2-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}+\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5} \\& =\tan ^{-1} 2(\text { দেখানো হল) }\end{aligned}$

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে দেখাও যে , $\quad \frac{m^{2}}{a^{2}}-\frac{2 m n}{a b} \cos x+\frac{n^{2}}{b^{2}}=\sin ^{2} x$.
questions.answer:
দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে পাই,


$\cos ^{-1} \frac{m}{a}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{n}{b}=x $


$\Rightarrow \cos ^{-1}\left\{\frac{m}{a} \cdot \frac{n}{b}-\sqrt{\left(1-\frac{m^{2}}{a^{2}}\right)\left(1-\frac{n^{2}}{b^{2}}\right)}\right\}=x $


$\Rightarrow \frac{m}{a} \cdot \frac{n}{b}-\sqrt{\left(1-\frac{m^{2}}{a^{2}}\right)\left(1-\frac{n^{2}}{b^{2}}\right)}=\cos x $


$\Rightarrow \sqrt{\left(1-\frac{m^{2}}{a^{2}}\right)\left(1-\frac{n^{2}}{b^{2}}\right)}=\left(\frac{m}{a} \cdot \frac{n}{b}-\cos x\right) $


$\Rightarrow 1-\frac{m^{2}}{a^{2}}-\frac{n^{2}}{b^{2}}+\frac{m^{2}}{a^{2}} \cdot \frac{n^{2}}{b^{2}}=\frac{m^{2}}{a^{2}} \cdot \frac{n^{2}}{b^{2}}-2 \frac{m n}{a b} \cos x+\cos ^{2} \mathrm{x} $


$\Rightarrow \frac{m^{2}}{a^{2}}-\frac{2 m n}{a b} \cos x+\frac{n^{2}}{b^{2}}=1-\cos ^{2} x=\sin ^{2} x $


$\therefore \frac{m^{2}}{a^{2}}-\frac{2 m n}{a b} \cos x+\frac{n^{2}}{b^{2}}=\sin ^{2} x $


(দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: সমাধান করঃ $2\left(\cos ^{2} x-\sin ^{2} x\right)=\sqrt{3}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $2\left(\cos ^{2} x-\sin ^{2} x\right)=\sqrt{3}$


$\Rightarrow 2 \cos 2 x=\sqrt{3}$


$\Rightarrow \cos 2 x=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=\cos \frac{\pi}{6}$


$\Rightarrow 2 \mathrm{x}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{6}$


$\mathrm{X}=\mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{12}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$

questions.question: সমাধান করঃ $f(x)+g(x)=f(2 x)+g(2 x)$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$f(x)=\sin x 3 g(x)=\cos x$


প্রশ্নমতে,


$f(x)+g(x)=f(2 x)+g(2 x)$


$\Rightarrow \cos x+\sin x=\cos 2 x+\sin 2 x$


$\Rightarrow \cos x-\cos 2 x=\sin 2 x-\sin x$


$\Rightarrow 2 \sin \frac{3 x}{2} \sin \frac{x}{2}=2 \cos \frac{3 x}{2} \sin \frac{x}{2}$


$\Rightarrow \sin \frac{x}{2}\left(\sin \frac{3 x}{2}-\cos \frac{3 x}{2}\right)=0$


এখন,


$ \therefore \sin \frac{x}{2}=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \frac{x}{2}=n \pi $


$ \Rightarrow x=2 n \pi, n \in Z $


অথবা,


$ \operatorname{Sin} \frac{3 x}{2}-\cos \frac{3 x}{2}=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \sin \frac{3 x}{2}=\cos \frac{3 x}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow \tan \frac{3 x}{2}=1 $


$ \Rightarrow \frac{3 x}{2}=(4 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4} $


$ \Rightarrow x=(4 n+1) \frac{\pi}{6}, n \in Z $


নির্ণেয় সমাধানঃ $x=2 n \pi,(4 n+1) \frac{\pi}{6}, n \in Z$

questions.question: সমাধান করঃ $4 g(x) \cdot g(2 x) \cdot g(3 x)=1$, যখন $0<x<\pi$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $g(x)=\cos x$


$\therefore 4 \cos x \cos 2 x \cos 3 x=1,0<x<\pi$


প্রশ্নমতে,


$\cos x \cdot \cos 2 x \cdot \cos 3 x=1$


$2 \cos 2 x \cdot 2 \cos 3 x \cdot \cos x=1$


$2 \cos 2 \cdot(\cos 4 x+\cos 2 x)=1$


$2 \cos 4 x \cdot \cos 2 x+\cos ^{2} x-1=0$


$2 \cos 4 x \cdot \cos 2 x+\cos 4 x=0$


$\cos 4 x(2 \cos 2 x+1)=0$


এখন,


$\cos 4 x=0$


$\Rightarrow 4 x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2}$


$\Rightarrow x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{8}, n \in Z$


অথবা,


$(2 \cos 2 x+1)=0$


$\Rightarrow \cos 2 x=-\frac{1}{2}=\cos \frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$\Rightarrow 2 x=2 n \pi \pm \frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$\Longrightarrow x=n \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, n \in Z$


$\therefore x=n \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}, x=n \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\therefore n=0$ হলে, $x=\frac{\pi}{8}, x=\frac{\pi}{3}, x=-\frac{\pi}{3}$


$\therefore n=1$ হলে, $x=\frac{3 \pi}{8}, x=\pi+\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{4 \pi}{3}$,


$x=\pi-\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$\therefore n=2$ হলে, $x=\frac{5 \pi}{8}, x=2 \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{7 \pi}{3}$,


$x=2 \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{5 \pi}{3}$


$\therefore n=3$ হলে, $x=\frac{7 \pi}{8}, x=3 \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}$,


$x=3 \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}$


নির্ণেয় মানসমূহঃ $\frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{\pi}{8}, \frac{3 \pi}{8}, \frac{2 \pi}{3}, \frac{5 \pi}{8}, \frac{7 \pi}{8}$

context: $ N=\tan ^{-1}\left(\operatorname{cosec} \tan ^{-1} x-\tan \cot ^{-1} x\right) $ এবং $ f(\theta)=\cos \theta $

questions.question: যদি $x=\frac{1}{2} \cos ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}$ হয়, তবে $\tan x$ এর মান কত হবে?
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$x=\frac{1}{2} \cos ^{-1} \frac{3}{4} \quad \therefore \tan x=\tan \left(\frac{1}{2} \cos ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}\right) \ldots(i)$


আমরা জানি,


$ 2 \tan ^{-1} a=\cos ^{-1} \frac{1-a^2}{1+a^2} $


$ \Rightarrow \tan ^{-1} a=\frac{1}{2} \cos ^{-1} \frac{1-a^2}{1+a^2} $


$ \Rightarrow a=\tan \left(\frac{1}{2} \cos ^{-1} \frac{1-a^2}{1+a^2}\right) \ldots (i i) $


(i) ও (ii) তুলনা করে,


$ \frac{1-a^2}{1+a^2}=\frac{3}{4} $


$ \Rightarrow 4-4 a^2=3+3 a^2 $


$ \Rightarrow 7 a^2=1 $


$ \Rightarrow a=\frac{1}{\sqrt{7}} $


$ \therefore \text { tanx }=\frac{1}{\sqrt{7}} $

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $N=\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} x$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ N=\tan ^{-1}\left(\operatorname{cosec} \tan ^{-1} x-\operatorname{tancot}^{-1} x\right)$


$ =\tan ^{-1}\left(\operatorname{cosec} \operatorname{cosec}-1 \frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}}{x}-\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{x}\right) $


$ =\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}}{x}-\frac{1}{x}\right) $


$ =\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}-1}{x}\right) $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}-1}{x}\right) $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \cdot \tan ^{-1} \frac{2 \cdot \frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}-1}{x}}{1-\frac{\left(\sqrt{1+x^2}-1\right)^2}{x^2}} $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \frac{2 \cdot \frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}-1}{x}}{\frac{x^2-\left\{\left(1+x^2\right)-2 \sqrt{1+x^2}+1\right\}}{x^2}} $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \frac{\frac{2 \sqrt{1+x^2}-2}{x}}{\frac{x^2-\left(1+x^2\right)+2 \sqrt{1+x^2}-1}{x^2}} $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \frac{2 \sqrt{1+x^2}-2}{x} \cdot \frac{x^2}{2 \sqrt{1+x^2}-2} $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} x $


$ \therefore N=\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} x $ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: সমাধান কর : $f(\theta)+f(2 \theta)+f(3 \theta)=0$ যখন, $-2 \pi \leq \theta \leq 2 \pi $
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(\theta)=\cos \theta$

$ \therefore f(2 \theta) =\cos 2 \theta $

$ f(3 \theta) =\cos 3 \theta $

এখানে, $f(\theta)+f(2 \theta)+f(3 \theta)=0$; যখন $-2 \pi \leq \theta \leq 2 \pi$

বা, $\cos \theta+\cos 2 \theta+\cos 3 \theta=0$

বা, $\cos 3 \theta+\cos \theta+\cos 2 \theta=0$

বা, $2 \cos \frac{3 \theta+\theta}{2} \cos \frac{3 \theta-\theta}{2}+\cos 2 \theta=0$

বা, $2 \cos 2 \theta \cos \theta+\cos 2 \theta=0$ বা, $\cos 2 \theta(2 \cos \theta+1)=0$

হয়, $\cos 2 \theta=0$

বা, $2 \theta=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2}$, যেখানে $n \in \mathbb{Z}$

$ \therefore \quad \theta=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4} $

অথবা, $2 \cos \theta+1=0$

বা, $2 \cos \theta=-1$

বা, $\cos \theta=-\frac{1}{2}=\cos \frac{2 \pi}{3}$

$\therefore \theta=2 n \pi \pm \frac{2 \pi}{3}$, যেখানে $n \in \mathbb{Z}$

$ \mathrm{n}=0 $ হলে,$ \theta=\frac{\pi}{4}, \pm \frac{2 \pi}{3} $

$ \mathrm{n}=1 $ হলে, $ \theta=\frac{3 \pi}{4}, \frac{8 \pi}{3}, \frac{4 \pi}{3} $

$ \mathrm{n}=-1 $ হলে, $ \theta=-\frac{\pi}{4},-\frac{4 \pi}{3},-\frac{8 \pi}{3} $

$ \mathrm{n}=2 $ হলে, $ \theta=\frac{5 \pi}{4}, \frac{14 \pi}{3}, \frac{10 \pi}{3} $

$ \mathrm{n}=-2 $ হলে, $ \theta=-\frac{3 \pi}{4},-\frac{10 \pi}{3},-\frac{14 \pi}{3} $

$ \mathrm{n}=3 $ হলে, $ \theta=\frac{7 \pi}{4}, \frac{20 \pi}{3}, \frac{16 \pi}{3} $

$ \mathrm{n}=-3 $ হলে, $ \theta=-\frac{5 \pi}{4},-\frac{16 \pi}{3},-\frac{20 \pi}{3} $

$ \mathrm{n}=4$ হলে, $ \theta=\frac{9 \pi}{4}, \frac{26 \pi}{3}, \frac{22 \pi}{3} $

$ \mathrm{n}=-4 $ হলে, $ \theta=-\frac{7 \pi}{4},-\frac{22 \pi}{3},-\frac{26 \pi}{3} $

$-2 \pi \leq \theta \leq 2 \pi$ ব্যবধিতে

$ \theta=-\frac{2 \pi}{3},-\frac{4 \pi}{3},-\frac{3 \pi}{4},-\frac{5 \pi}{4},-\frac{7 \pi}{4},-\frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{2 \pi}{3}, \frac{3 \pi}{4}, \frac{4 \pi}{3}, \frac{5 \pi}{4}, \frac{7 \pi}{4} $

নির্ণেয় সমাধান :

$ \theta=-\frac{2 \pi}{3},-\frac{4 \pi}{3},-\frac{3 \pi}{4},-\frac{5 \pi}{4},-\frac{7 \pi}{4},-\frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{2 \pi}{3}, \frac{3 \pi}{4}, \frac{4 \pi}{3}, \frac{5 \pi}{4}, \frac{7 \pi}{4} . $

questions.question: $\cot ^{-1} x+\cot ^{-1} y=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে দেখাও যে, $x y=1$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ \cot ^{-1} x+\cot ^{-1} y=\frac{\pi}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow \tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{x}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{y}=\frac{\pi}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y}}{1-\frac{1}{x}}\right)=\frac{\pi}{2}$


$ \Rightarrow \frac{\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y}}{1-\frac{1}{x y}}=\tan \frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{1}{0} $


$ \Rightarrow 1-\frac{1}{x y}=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \frac{1}{x y}=1 $


$ \therefore x y=1 $ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ থেকে সমাধান কর : $\mid 2 g$ ( $\pi-x) $g(3 x)=1$, যখন, $0 \leq x \leq 2 \pi$
questions.answer:
দৃশ্যকল্প-১ থেকে,


$g(x)=\sin x$


প্রশ্নমতে,


$ 2 g(\pi-x) g(3 x)=1 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \sin (\pi-x) \sin 3 x=1 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \sin x \sin 3 x=1 $


$ \Rightarrow \cos 2 x-\cos 4 x-1=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \cos 2 x-(1+\cos 4 x)=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \cos ^2 2 x-\cos 2 x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \cos 2 x(2 \cos 2 x-1)=0 $


$ \therefore \cos 2 x=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 2 x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2} $


$ \therefore x=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4}, n \in z $

$\left|\begin{matrix} or, \cos 2 x=\frac{1}{2}=\cos \frac{\pi}{3} \\ \Rightarrow 2 x=2 n \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3} \\ \therefore x=n \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{6}, n \in z\end{matrix}\right.$


$ \therefore x=n \pi+\frac{\pi}{6} ; x=n \pi-\frac{\pi}{6}, n \in z $


$ n=0 $ হলে, $ x=\frac{\pi}{4}, x=\frac{\pi}{6}, x=-\frac{\pi}{6} $


$ n=1 $ হলে, $ x=\frac{3 \pi}{4}, x=\frac{7 \pi}{6}, x=\frac{5 \pi}{6} $


$ n=2 $ হলে, $ x=\frac{11 \pi}{6}, x=\frac{13 \pi}{6}, x=\frac{5 \pi}{4} $


$ n=3 $ হলে, $ x=\frac{7 \pi}{4}, x=\frac{17 \pi}{6}, x=\frac{19 \pi}{6} $


$ \therefore 0 \leq x \leq 2 \pi $ সীমার মধ্যে :


$ \qquad x=\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5 \pi}{6}, \frac{7 \pi}{6}, \frac{11 \pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{3 \pi}{4}, \frac{5 \pi}{4}, \frac{7 \pi}{4} $


নির্ণেয় সমাধান: $ x=\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5 \pi}{6}, \frac{7 \pi}{6}, \frac{11 \pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{3 \pi}{4}, \frac{5 \pi}{4}, \frac{7 \pi}{4} $

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ এ $f(x)+f(y)+f(z)=\pi$ হলে দেখাও যে, $x^2+y^2+z^2+2 x y z=1$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=\cos ^{-1} x$


$ \therefore f(x)+f(y)+f(z)=\pi $


$\Rightarrow \cos ^{-1} x+\cos ^{-1} y+\cos ^{-1} z=\pi $


$\Rightarrow \cos ^{-1}\left(x y-\sqrt{1-x^2} \sqrt{1-y^2}\right)=\pi-\cos ^{-1} z $


$\Rightarrow x y-\sqrt{\left(1-x^{2}\right)\left(1-y^{2}\right)}=\cos \left(\pi-\cos ^{-1} z\right)=-\cos \cos ^{-1} z=-z$


$\Rightarrow x y+z=\sqrt{\left(1-x^{2}\right)\left(1-y^{2}\right)}$


$\Rightarrow x^{2} y^{2}+2 x y z+z^{2}=1-y^{2}-x^{2}+x^{2} y^{2}$ [বর্গ করে]


$x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}+2 x y z=1$ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $\operatorname{cosec} \sin ^{-1} \tan \sec ^{-1} \frac{x}{y}=\frac{y}{\sqrt{x^{2}-y^{2}}}$
$\mathrm{f}(\theta)=\frac{3}{4}$ হলে, দেখাও যে, $\theta= \pm \sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{24}{25}\right)$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$f(x)=\operatorname{cosec} x-\cot x$


$ \Rightarrow \mathrm{f}(\theta)=\operatorname{cosec} \theta-\cot \theta $


$ \Rightarrow \operatorname{cosec} \theta-\cot \theta=\frac{3}{4} $


$ \Rightarrow \frac{1-\cos \theta}{\sin \theta}=\frac{3}{4} \Rightarrow \frac{(1-\cos \theta)^{2}}{\sin ^{2} \theta}=\frac{9}{16} $


$ \Rightarrow 16\left(1-2 \cos \theta+\cos ^{2} \theta\right)=9 \sin ^{2} \theta $


$ \Rightarrow 16-32 \cos \theta+16 \cos ^{2} \theta=9-9 \cos ^{2} \theta $


$ \Rightarrow 25 \cos ^{2} \theta-25 \cos \theta-7 \cos \theta+7=0 $


$ \Rightarrow 25 \cos \theta(\cos \theta-1)-7(\cos \theta-1)=0 $


$ \Rightarrow(\cos \theta-1)(25 \cos \theta-7)=0 $


$ \therefore \cos \theta=1 $


অথবা,


$ 25 \cos \theta=7 $ [গ্রহনযোগ্য নয়]


$ \Rightarrow \cos \theta=\frac{7}{25} $


$ \Rightarrow \sin \theta= \pm \frac{24}{25} $


$ \Rightarrow \theta=\sin ^{-1}\left( \pm \frac{24}{25}\right) $


$ \therefore \theta= \pm \sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{24}{25}\right) $


(দেখানো হল)

questions.question: $\mathrm{g}(5 \theta)-\sqrt{3} \mathrm{~g}(\theta)=\mathrm{g}(3 \theta)$ সমীকরণটির সাধারণ সমাধান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ g(x)=\sin x $


এখন, $ g(5 \theta)-\sqrt{3} g(\theta)=g(3 \theta) $


$ \Rightarrow \sin 5 \theta-\sqrt{3} \sin \theta=\sin 3 \theta $


$ \Rightarrow \sin 5 \theta-\sin 3 \theta=\sqrt{3} \sin \theta $


$ \Rightarrow 2 \cos 4 \theta \sin \theta-\sqrt{3} \sin \theta=0 $


$ \Rightarrow \sin \theta(2 \cos 4 \theta-\sqrt{3})=0 $


$\therefore \sin \theta=0$


$\Rightarrow \theta=\mathrm{n} \pi$. n€Z $


$or, 2cos 4\theta = \sqrt{3}$


$\Rightarrow cos 4\theta$


$=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=cos\frac{\pi}{6}$


$\Rightarrow 4\theta = 2n\pi \pm \frac{\pi}{6}$


$\Rightarrow \theta = \frac {n\pi}{2}\pm \frac{\pi}{24}n\epsilon z$


$\therefore$ নির্ণেয় সমাধান : $ \theta = \frac {n\pi}{2}\pm \frac{\pi}{24}n\epsilon z$

questions.question: সমাধান কর: $\tan 2 \mathrm{x}-\tan \mathrm{x}=0$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$\tan 2 \mathrm{x}-\tan \mathrm{x}=0$


$\Rightarrow \frac{\sin 2 x}{\cos 2 x}-\frac{\sin x}{\cos x}=0$


$\Rightarrow \frac{\sin 2 x \cos x-\sin x \cos 2 x}{\cos 2 x \cos x}=0$


$\Rightarrow \sin (2 x-x)=0 \quad \Rightarrow \sin x=0$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}=\mathrm{n} \pi, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$

questions.question: সমাধান কর: $\sqrt{2} \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})-\sqrt{2} \mathrm{f}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{x}\right)=1$; যখন, $-\pi<\mathrm{x}<\pi$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\cos \mathrm{x}$


GLb, $\sqrt{2} \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})-\sqrt{2} \mathrm{f}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{x}\right)=1$


$\Rightarrow \sqrt{2} \cos x-\sqrt{2} \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)=1$


$ \Rightarrow \sqrt{2} \cos x-\sqrt{2} \sin x=1 $


$\left\{\begin{matrix}\sqrt{(\sqrt{2})^{2}+(\sqrt{2})^{2}}\\=\sqrt{2+2}=\sqrt{4}\\=2 দ্বারা ভাগ\end{matrix}\right.$


$ \Rightarrow \cos x \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}-\sin x \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}=\frac{1}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow \cos x \cos \frac{\pi}{4}-\sin x \sin \frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{1}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow \cos \left(x+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\cos \frac{\pi}{3} $


$ \Rightarrow \mathrm{x}+\frac{\pi}{4}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z} $


$ (+\mathrm{ve}) \Rightarrow \mathrm{x}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{3}-\frac{\pi}{4}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi+\frac{\pi}{12}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z} $


$ (-\mathrm{ve}) \Rightarrow \mathrm{x}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi-\frac{\pi}{3}-\frac{\pi}{4}=2 \mathrm{n} \pi-\frac{7 \pi}{12}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z} $


$ \mathrm{n}=0 $ হলে, $\mathrm{x}=\frac{\pi}{12}, \mathrm{x}=-\frac{7 \pi}{12} $


$ \mathrm{n}=1 $ হলে, $ \mathrm{x}=2 \pi+\frac{\pi}{12}, \mathrm{x}=2 \pi-\frac{7 \pi}{12}=\frac{17 \pi}{12} $

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}=\frac{\pi}{2}$ সমীকরণটি একটি উপবৃত্ত নির্দেশ করে।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ A=\sec ^{-1} \frac{2}{x} \text { এবং } B=\sec ^{-1} \frac{3}{y} $


$ \therefore A+B=\frac{\pi}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow \sec ^{-1} \frac{2}{x}+\sec ^{-1} \frac{3}{y}=\frac{\pi}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow \cos ^{-1} \frac{x}{2}+\cos ^{-1} \frac{y}{3}=\frac{\pi}{2} $


$ \Rightarrow \cos ^{-1}\left\{\frac{x}{2} \cdot \frac{y}{3}-\left(\sqrt{1-\frac{x^{2}}{4}} \cdot \sqrt{1-\frac{y^{2}}{9}}\right)\right\}=\frac{\pi}{2} $


$\Rightarrow \frac{x}{2} \cdot \frac{y}{3}-\left(\sqrt{1-\frac{x^{2}}{4}} \cdot \sqrt{1-\frac{y^{2}}{9}}\right)=\cos \frac{\pi}{2}=0$


$\Rightarrow \sqrt{1-\frac{x^{2}}{4}} \cdot \sqrt{1-\frac{y^{2}}{9}}=\frac{x y}{6}$


$\Rightarrow\left(1-\frac{x^{2}}{4}\right)\left(1-\frac{y^{2}}{9}\right)=\frac{x^{2} y^{2}}{36}$


$\Rightarrow 1-\frac{y^{2}}{9}-\frac{x^{2}}{4}+\frac{x^{2} y^{2}}{36}=\frac{x^{2} y^{2}}{36}$


$\Rightarrow \frac{x^{2}}{4}+\frac{y^{2}}{9}=1 \quad \Rightarrow \frac{x^{2}}{2^{2}}+\frac{y^{2}}{3^{2}}=1$


নির্ণেয় সমীকরণটি একটি উপবৃত্তের সমীকরণ।

questions.question: $\sin ^{-1} m+\sin ^{-1} n=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে, প্রমাণ কর যে, $m^2+$ $n^2=1$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\sin ^{-1} m+\sin ^{-1} n=\frac{\pi}{2}$


বা, $\sin ^{-1} m=\frac{\pi}{2}-\sin ^{-1} n$


বা, $m=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\sin ^{-1} n\right)$


বা, $m=\cos \left(\sin ^{-1} n\right)$


বা, $\mathrm{m}^2=\cos ^2\left(\sin ^{-1} \mathrm{n}\right)$ [বর্গ করে]


বা, $\mathrm{m}^2=1-\sin ^2\left(\sin ^{-1} n\right)$


বা, $m^2=1-\left\{\sin \left(\sin ^{-1} n\right)\right\}^2$


বা, $\mathrm{m}^2=1-\mathrm{n}^2$


$\therefore \mathrm{m}^2+\mathrm{n}^2=1$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $0 \leq \theta \leq 2 \pi$ ব্যবধিতে $2 \mathrm{~h}(\theta), \mathrm{h}(3 \theta)=1$ সমীকরণটির সমাধান কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{h}(\mathrm{x})=\sin \mathrm{x}$ এবং $2 \mathrm{~h}(\theta) \cdot \mathrm{h}(3 \theta)=$ $1 ; 0 \leq \theta \leq 2 \pi$


বা, $2 \sin \theta \cdot \sin 3 \theta=1$


বা, $\cos (3 \theta-\theta)-\cos (3 \theta+\theta)=1$


বা, $\cos 2 \theta-\cos 4 \theta=1$


বা, $\cos 2 \theta=1+\cos 4 \theta$


বা, $\cos 2 \theta=2 \cos ^2 2 \theta$


বা, $2 \cos ^2 2 \theta-\cos 2 \theta=0$


বা, $\cos 2 \theta(2 \cos 2 \theta-1)=0$


হয়, $\cos 2 \theta=0$


বা, $2 \theta=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{2}$


বা, $\theta=(2 n+1) \frac{\pi}{4}$


অথবা, $2 \cos 2 \theta-1=0$


বা, $\cos 2 \theta=\frac{1}{2}$


বা, $\cos 2 \theta=\cos \frac{\pi}{3}$


বা, $2 \theta=2 \mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{3}$


বা, $\theta=\mathrm{n} \pi \pm \frac{\pi}{6}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathrm{Z}$


$ \mathrm{n}=0 $ হলে, $ \theta=\frac{\pi}{4}, \pm \frac{\pi}{6} $


$ n=1 $ হলে, $ \theta=\frac{3 \pi}{4}, \frac{7 \pi}{6}, \frac{5 \pi}{6} $


$ \mathrm{n}=2 $ হলে $ \theta=\frac{5 \pi}{4}, \frac{13 \pi}{6}, \frac{11 \pi}{6} $


$ n=3 $ হলে, $ \theta=\frac{7 \pi}{4}, \frac{19 \pi}{6}, \frac{17 \pi}{6} $


$ 0 \leq \theta \leq 2 \pi $ ব্যবধিতে নির্ণেয় সমাধান :


$ \theta=\frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{3 \pi}{4}, \frac{7 \pi}{6}, \frac{5 \pi}{6}, \frac{5 \pi}{4}, \frac{11 \pi}{6}, \frac{7 \pi}{4} $

questions.question: $\operatorname{cosec}^{-1} \sqrt{17}+\sec ^{-1} \frac{\sqrt{26}}{5}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
প্রদত্ত রাশি $=\operatorname{cosec}^{-1} \sqrt{17}+\sec ^{-1} \frac{\sqrt{26}}{5}$


$=\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{4}+\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{5}$


$=\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{5}}{1-\frac{1}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{5}}\right)$


$=\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{5+4}{20-1}\right)$


$=\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{9}{19}\right)=\tan ^{-1} \frac{9}{19}$


নির্ণেয় মান : $\tan ^{-1} \frac{9}{19}$.

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ থেকে, A + C - $\frac{1}{2}$ B এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$ \sec A=\sqrt{5} $ এবং $ \operatorname{cosec} B=\frac{5}{3} $


বা, $ A=\sec ^{-1} \sqrt{5} $ বা, $ B=\operatorname{cosec}^{-1} \frac{5}{3} $


এবং $\cot C=3$


বা, $C=\cot ^{-1} 3$


প্রদত্ত রাশি $ =\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{C}-\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{~B} $


$ =\sec ^{-1} \sqrt{5}+\cot ^{-1} 3-\frac{1}{2} \operatorname{cosec}^{-1} \frac{5}{3} $


$ =\tan ^{-1} 2+\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{3}-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5} $


$ =\tan ^{-1} 2+\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{3}-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5} $


$ =\tan ^{-1} 2+\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{2 \cdot \frac{1}{3}}{1+\frac{1}{9}}-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5} $


$ =\tan ^{-1} 2+\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{6}{9+1}\right)-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5} $


$ =\tan ^{-1} 2+\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}-\frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}=\tan ^{-1} 2 $


নির্ণেয় মান $\tan ^{-1} 2$.

questions.question: সমাধান কর : দৃশ্যকল্প-২ থেকে $\sqrt{3} f(x)-f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+x\right)=$ 2, যখন $-2 \pi<x<2 \pi$.$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=\sin x$


এখানে, $\sqrt{3} f(x)-f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+x\right)=2$


বা, $\sqrt{3} \sin x-\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}+x\right)=2$


বা, $\sqrt{3} \sin x-\cos x=2$


বা, $\cos x-\sqrt{3} \sin x=-2$


বা, $\frac{1}{2} \cos x-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \sin x=-1$


[উভয়পক্ষকে $\sqrt{1^2+(-\sqrt{3})^2}$ বা, 2 দ্বারা ভাগ করে]


বা, $\cos x \cdot \cos \frac{\pi}{3}-\sin x \cdot \sin \frac{\pi}{3}=-1$


বা, $\cos \left(x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=-1$


বা, $x+\frac{\pi}{3}=(2 n+1) \pi ; n \in Z$


বা, $x=2 n \pi+\pi-\frac{\pi}{3}=2 n \pi+\frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$\therefore x=2 n \pi+\frac{2 \pi}{3}$,


$\mathrm{n}=0$ হলে, $\mathrm{x}=\frac{2 \pi}{3}$


$ n=1 $ হলে, $ x=2 \pi+\frac{2 \pi}{3}=\frac{8 \pi}{3} $


$n=-1$ হলে, $x=-2 \pi+\frac{2 \pi}{3}=\frac{-4 \pi}{3}$


$-2 \pi<x<2 \pi$ ব্যবধিতে নির্ণয় সমাধান : $x=\frac{-4 \pi}{3}, \frac{2 \pi}{3}$.

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এর কণিকটির সমীকরণ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:

উপকেন্দ্র, $S(-2,3)$


শীর্ষবিন্দু $A(5,3)$


ধরি, $Z(a, b)$


$\mathrm{SZ}$ এর মধ্যবিন্দু $\left(\frac{a-2}{2}, \frac{\mathrm{b}+3}{2}\right)$


প্রশ্নমতে, $\left(\frac{a-2}{2}, \frac{b+3}{2}\right)=(5,3)$


$\therefore \frac{a-2}{2}=5$


বা, $a-2=10$


বা, $a=12$


এবং $\frac{b+3}{2}=3$


বা, $b+3=6$


বা, $b=3$


$z(12,3)$


$\mathrm{SZ}$ রেখার ঢাল $=\frac{3-3}{-2-12}=0$


$\therefore$ নিয়ামক রেখার ঢাল $=\frac{-1}{0}$.


$Z(12,3)$ বিন্দুগামী নিয়ামক রেখা :


$y-3=-\frac{-1}{0}(x-12)$


বা, $x-12=0$


$\therefore M Z$ রেখা : $x-12=0$


ধরি, পরাবৃত্তের উপর যে কোন বিন্দু $P(x, y)$


সংজ্ঞানুসারে, SP = PM


বা, $\sqrt{(\mathrm{x}+2)^2+(\mathrm{y}-3)^2}=\frac{|\mathrm{x}-12|}{\sqrt{1}}$


বা, $(x+2)^2+(y-3)^2=(x-12)^2$ [বর্গ করে]


বা, $x^2+4 x+4+y^2-6 y+9=x^2-24 x+144$


$ \therefore \mathrm{y}^2+28 \mathrm{x}-6 \mathrm{y}-131=0 $


নির্ণেয় কণিকটির সমীকরণ, $y^2+28 x-6 y-131=0$.

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ এর উপবৃত্তটির উৎকেন্দ্রিকতা $\frac{3}{4}$ হলে উপকেন্দ্রিক লম্বের দৈর্ঘ্য নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
ধরি, উপবৃত্তের সমীকরণ, $\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$


দেওয়া আছে, উৎকেন্দ্রিকতা, e = $\frac{3}{4}$


উপকেন্দ্র ও তার নিকটতম নিয়ামকের দূরত্ব = 14


$ \therefore \frac{\mathrm{a}}{\mathrm{e}}-\mathrm{ae}=14 $


বা, $a\left(\frac{1}{e}-e\right)=14$


বা, $a\left(\frac{4}{3}-\frac{3}{4}\right)=14$


বা, $a\left(\frac{16-9}{12}\right)=14$


বা, $a \cdot \frac{7}{12}=14$


বা, $a \frac{1}{12}=2$


বা, $a=24$


বা, $a^2=576$


আবার, $\mathrm{e}=\frac{3}{4}$


বা, $e^2=\frac{9}{16}$


বা, $\frac{a^2-b^2}{a^2}=\frac{9}{16}$


বা, $9 a^2=16 a^2-16 b^2$


বা, $16 \mathrm{~b}^2=7 \mathrm{a}^2$


বা, $16 b^2=7 .(24)^2[\because a=24]$


বা, $16 \mathrm{~b}^2=7 \times 576$


বা, $b^2=\frac{7 \times 576}{16}=252$


$\therefore$ উপকেন্দ্রিক লম্নের দৈর্ঘ্য $=\frac{2 b^2}{a}=\frac{2 \times 252}{24}=21$ একক নির্ণেয় উপকেন্দ্রিক লম্বের দৈর্ঘ্য 21 একক।

questions.question: $f\left\{\sqrt{2} g\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\right\}+f\{\sqrt{g(2 \theta)}\}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=\sin ^{-1} x$ এবং $g(x)=\cos x$


এখন $ f\left\{\sqrt{2} g\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\right\}+f\{\sqrt{g(2 \theta)}\} $


$ =\sin ^{-1}\left\{\sqrt{2} \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\right\}+\sin ^{-1}\{\sqrt{\cos (2 \theta)}\} $


$ =\sin ^{-1}\{\sqrt{2} \sin \theta\}+\sin ^{-1}\{\sqrt{\cos 2 \theta}\} $


$ =\sin ^{-1}\{\sqrt{2} \sin \theta \sqrt{1-\cos 2 \theta}+ \left.\sqrt{\cos 2 \theta} \sqrt{1-2 \sin ^2 \theta}\right\} $


$ =\sin ^{-1}\left\{\sqrt{2} \sin \theta \sqrt{2 \sin ^2 \theta}+\sqrt{\cos 2 \theta} \sqrt{\cos 2 \theta}\right\} $


$ =\sin ^{-1}\{\sqrt{2} \sin \theta \sqrt{2} \sin \theta+\cos 2 \theta\} $


$ =\sin ^{-1}\{2 \sin \theta+\cos 2 \theta\} $


$ =\sin ^{-1}\{1-\cos 2 \theta+\cos 2 \theta\}=\sin ^{-1} 1=\frac{\pi}{2} $


নির্নেয় মান $\frac{\pi}{2}$

questions.question: $\cot \left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\right)$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
প্রদত্ত রাশি

 

$=\cot \left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\right)$

 

$=\cot \left(\cot ^{-1} 2\right)$

 

$=2$

 

নির্ণেয় মান: 2।

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে যদি $g(\alpha)=0$ হয়, তবে দেখাও যে, $\alpha= \pm \frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

 

$ g(\alpha)=\sin (\pi \cos \alpha)-\cos (\pi \sin \alpha) $

 

$ \mathrm{g}(\alpha)=0 $ হলে, $ \sin (\pi \cos \alpha)-\cos (\pi \sin \alpha)=0 $

 

বা, $\sin (\pi \cos \alpha)=\cos (\pi \sin \alpha)$

 

বা, $\sin (\pi \cos \alpha)=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi \sin \alpha\right)$

 

বা, $\pi \cos \alpha=\frac{\pi}{2} \pm \pi \sin \alpha$

 

বা, $\cos \alpha=\frac{1}{2} \pm \sin \alpha$

 

বা, $\cos \alpha \pm \sin \alpha=\frac{1}{2}$

 

বা, $(\cos \alpha \pm \sin \alpha)^{2}=\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2}$ [বর্গ করে]

 

বা, $\cos ^{2} \theta+\sin ^{2} \theta \pm 2 \cos \alpha \cdot \sin \alpha=\frac{1}{4}$

 

বা, $1 \pm \sin 2 \alpha=\frac{1}{4}$

 

বা, $\pm \sin 2 \alpha=\frac{1}{4}-1$

 

বা, $\pm \sin 2 \alpha=\frac{-3}{4}$

 

বা, $\sin 2 \alpha= \pm \frac{3}{4}$

 

বা, $2 \alpha= \pm \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}$

 

$\therefore \alpha= \pm \frac{1}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{4}$ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ হতে $f(\mathrm{a})=\alpha$ হলে, প্রমাণ কর যে, $\sin \alpha=\sqrt{a^{2}+b^{2}-2 a b \cos \alpha}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(a)=\sec ^{-1} \frac{1}{a}+\sec ^{-1} \frac{1}{b}$

 

$ f(a)=\alpha $ হলে, $ \sec ^{-1} \frac{1}{a}+\sec ^{-1} \frac{1}{b}=\alpha $

 

বা, $\cos ^{-1} \mathrm{a}+\cos ^{-1} \mathrm{~b}=\alpha$

 

বা, $\cos ^{-1}\left(\mathrm{ab}-\sqrt{\left(1-a^{2}\right)\left(1-b^{2}\right)}=\alpha\right.$

 

বা, $a b-\sqrt{\left(1-a^{2}\right)\left(1-b^{2}\right)}=\cos \alpha$

 

বা, $\mathrm{ab}-\cos \alpha=\sqrt{\left(1-a^{2}\right)\left(1-b^{2}\right)}$

 

বা, $(a b-\cos \alpha)^{2}=\left(1-a^{2}\right)\left(1-b^{2}\right) \quad$ [বর্গ করে]

 

বা, $a^{2} b^{2}-2 a b \cos \alpha+\cos ^{2} \alpha=1-b^{2}-a^{2}+a^{2} b^{2}$

 

বা, $a^{2}+b^{2}-2 a b \cos \alpha=1-\cos ^{2} \alpha$

 

বা, $a^{2}+b^{2}-2 a b \cos \alpha=\sin ^{2} \alpha$

 

বা, $\sin ^{2} \alpha=a^{2}+b^{2}-2 a b \cos \alpha$

 

$\therefore \sin \alpha=\sqrt{a^{2}+b^{2}-2 a b \cos \alpha}$
